ddl.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header (Data Definition Language) grouping options for CREATE / ALTER statements such as aligning column data types; usually kept as the acronym.

dialect.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the choice of SQL dialect the formatter targets.

dml.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header (Data Manipulation Language) grouping options for INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE statements; usually kept as the acronym.

format_triggers.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping checkboxes that format SQL automatically on save or on paste.

functions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for function-name case, argument layout and spacing before parentheses.

identifier_formatting.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for the case and quoting of table and column names.

indentation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping indent style, width and nested-query indentation options.

joins.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for JOIN layout and ON clause placement; JOIN is the SQL keyword.

keyword_casing.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for the letter case of SQL keywords.

line_length.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping the maximum line length, line wrapping and short-query options.

operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for spaces around and alignment of operators such as = and <>.

preset.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header above the dropdown that applies a named bundle of formatting settings.

select_list.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping options for how the column list after SELECT is laid out.

statements.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping semicolon placement and blank-line limits between statements.

subqueries_ctes.value: 子查询 / 公共表表达式 (CTEs)
subqueries_ctes.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header grouping layout options for nested subqueries and common table expressions (WITH clauses).

try_it.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: section header above the live preview area where users pick or type sample SQL and see it formatted.

align_column_aliases.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → SELECT list: checkbox label for the option that lines up the AS aliases of SELECT columns in one vertical column.

align_comparison_operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Operators: checkbox label for the option that vertically lines up comparison operators such as = across consecutive condition lines.

align_data_types.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that lines up column data types in a column within CREATE TABLE definitions.

align_nullability.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that lines up the NULL / NOT NULL markers in a column within CREATE TABLE definitions.

align_set_operators.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that lines up the = signs of the column assignments in an UPDATE … SET list.

align_values_rows.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that lines up the values of each row tuple in an INSERT … VALUES list so they form columns.

blank_line_before_clauses.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: checkbox label for the option that inserts an empty line before major clauses such as FROM, WHERE and GROUP BY.

break_after_select.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Clause layout: checkbox label for the option that puts a line break right after the SELECT keyword so the first column starts on the next line.

constraints_after_columns.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that places table constraints after all column definitions in CREATE TABLE statements.

format_as_you_go.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting: checkbox label for the option near the top of the pane that reformats the current statement each time Enter is pressed in the editor.

format_inside_block_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that lets the formatter also reformat SQL text found inside /* … */ block comments.

format_on_paste.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Format triggers: checkbox label for the option that automatically formats SQL pasted into the editor.

format_on_save.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Format triggers: checkbox label for the option that automatically formats the query file whenever it is saved.

indent_join_on_conditions.value: 缩进 JOIN ON 条件
indent_join_on_conditions.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that indents the ON conditions of a JOIN one level deeper than the JOIN line.

indent_nested_queries.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that indents the body of nested subqueries one level inside their parentheses.

insert_one_column_per_line.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that puts each column of an INSERT statement's column list on its own line; “INSERT” is the SQL keyword.

keep_inline_comments_inline.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that keeps end-of-line -- comments on the same line as the code they follow.

merge_section_separation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DML: checkbox label for the option that separates the WHEN MATCHED / WHEN NOT MATCHED sections of a MERGE statement onto distinct blocks.

move_trailing_comments.value: 将尾随注释与表达式一起移动
move_trailing_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that keeps a trailing comment attached to its expression when the formatter moves that expression to another line.

multi_condition_on.value: 多条件 ON（每个条件单独一行）
multi_condition_on.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → JOINs: checkbox label for the option that, when a JOIN's ON clause has several AND/OR conditions, puts each condition on its own line.

multiline_index_columns.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → DDL: checkbox label for the option that puts each column of a CREATE INDEX column list on its own line.

new_line_after_with.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Subqueries / CTEs: checkbox label for the option that starts the first common table expression on a new line after the WITH keyword.

parenthesize_mixed_boolean.value: 对混合布尔逻辑加括号
parenthesize_mixed_boolean.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Boolean conditions: checkbox label for the option that adds clarifying parentheses where AND and OR are mixed in one condition.

per_category_casing.value: 为每个关键字类别启用单独的大写/小写
per_category_casing.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Keyword casing: checkbox label that, when checked, reveals ten extra dropdowns so each keyword category (such as data types or functions) gets its own letter case.

respect_control_comments.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Comments: checkbox label for the option that makes the formatter obey special comments that switch formatting off and on for a region of SQL.

short_queries_one_line.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: checkbox label for the option that leaves queries shorter than the short query length on a single line; checking it reveals the “Short query max length” input.

space_before_function_parens.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Functions: checkbox label for the option that inserts a space between a function name and its opening parenthesis, as in “COUNT (*)”.

spaces_around_operators_etc.value: 运算符周围加空格（=、<>、+ 等）
spaces_around_operators_etc.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Operators: checkbox label for the option that puts a space on both sides of operators such as =, <> and +.

use_editor_indentation.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Indentation: checkbox label for the option that makes the formatter use the editor's own tab and indent width settings; unchecking it reveals separate indent style, width and continuation indent controls.

wrap_long_lines.location: Settings → Editor → Formatting → Line length: checkbox label for the option that breaks lines longer than the maximum line length onto further lines.

enter_a_number_e_g_0_25.location: Settings → Results → Decimal → Decimal places: inline validation error shown when the decimal-place value is not numeric.

enter_a_whole_number.location: Settings → Results → Integer → Decimal places: inline validation error shown when the integer-place value is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_2.location: Settings → Results → General → Auto-size columns: inline validation error shown when the column-width limit is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_3.location: Settings → Results → Performance → Result paging: inline validation error shown when a paging size is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_4.location: Settings → Editor → Query History → Retention: inline validation error shown when a retention value is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_5.location: Settings → AI → Autocomplete (FIM) → Generation: inline validation error shown when a generation parameter is not a whole number.

enter_a_whole_number_6.location: Settings → Workspace → Advanced → Limits: inline validation error shown when a numeric limit is not a whole number.

corrupt_store.value: {error}。计划任务未保存 — 请先修复或移动该文件
corrupt_store.location: Main window → Status bar: error shown when saving scheduled database dump tasks is refused because the existing schedule file on disk is unreadable; {error} is the parse error and the sentence continues after it.

save_failed.location: Main window → Status bar: error shown when writing the scheduled database dump task list to disk fails; {path} is the schedule file's full path and {error} is the system error.

building_catalog.value: 正在构建 AI 缓存和嵌入…（这可能需要一些时间）
building_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: progress message shown after the user runs “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” on a connected server, while SQLLY precomputes AI descriptions and vector embeddings for its schema.

capture_plan_first.value: 首先捕获执行计划（Explain / Actual Plan）。
capture_plan_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI plan explanation: hint shown when “Explain Execution Plan (AI)” is run but the active query tab has no captured execution plan; tells the user to capture a plan first.

catalog_build_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: error shown when building the AI cache and embeddings for the connected server fails; {error} is the underlying error text.

catalog_built.value: AI 目录已构建：嵌入了 {embedded} 个 {processed} 对象（{failed} 失败，{stale} 仍然过时）。
catalog_built.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: success message after “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” finishes; {embedded} embedded objects, {processed} processed objects, {failed} failures, {stale} entries still out of date.

clear_failed.value: 无法清除 AI 数据：{error}
clear_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: error shown when “Clear AI Catalog Data” fails to wipe the AI descriptions and embeddings for the connected server; {error} is the underlying error text.

clearing_catalog.value: 正在清除 AI 目录数据…
clearing_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: progress message shown while “Clear AI Catalog Data” deletes the AI-generated descriptions and embeddings for the connected server.

connect_build_catalog.value: 请先连接数据库以构建其 AI 目录。
connect_build_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: hint shown when “Build AI Cache and Embeddings” is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server before building the AI catalog.

connect_clear_data.value: 请先连接数据库以清除其 AI 数据。
connect_clear_data.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: hint shown when “Clear AI Catalog Data” is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server before clearing its AI data.

data_cleared.value: 已清除 AI 数据：{cards} 张卡片失效，{embeddings} 个嵌入被删除。
data_cleared.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI catalog: success message after “Clear AI Catalog Data” finishes; {cards} is the number of AI description cards invalidated, {embeddings} the number of vector embeddings deleted.

explain_selection_prompt.value:
解释此 SQL 并指出任何问题：
{sql}
explain_selection_prompt.location: AI panel → Ask → Prompt box: prefilled question inserted by “Send Selection to AI”, asking the AI to explain the selected SQL and point out problems; {sql} is the selected SQL placed on the next line.

fix_changed_statement.value: 出错语句的文本自错误以来已更改。已在插入符处插入修复。
fix_changed_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice after applying an AI fix when the failing statement was edited since the error, so the fixed SQL was inserted at the cursor instead of replacing the statement.

fix_empty_sql.value: AI 的答案没有可用的 SQL。
fix_empty_sql.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the user applies an AI error-fix answer that contains no usable SQL, so nothing is changed in the query editor.

fix_missing_position.value: 错误未说明哪条语句失败。已在插入符处插入修复。
fix_missing_position.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice after applying an AI fix when the error had no known statement position, so the fixed SQL was inserted at the cursor instead of replacing the failing statement.

fix_not_editable.value: 失败的标签页不再包含可编辑脚本。
fix_not_editable.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when an AI fix targets a tab that cannot be edited (a result snapshot, DDL view or notebook tab), so the fix is not applied.

fix_replaced_statement.value: 已替换失败的语句 — ⌘Z 可恢复旧文本。
fix_replaced_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: success message after the AI-suggested SQL replaced the single failing statement in its query tab as one undoable edit.

fix_replaced_whole_run.value: AI 的答案重写了整个脚本，所以整个运行已被替换 — ⌘Z 可恢复旧文本。
fix_replaced_whole_run.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: success message after the AI-suggested SQL replaced the entire SQL that was run (not just one statement) in its query tab as one undoable edit.

fix_stale_run.value: 该标签页自错误以来已重新运行，因此此修复已不再适用。解释新结果以获取新的修复，或使用插入。
fix_stale_run.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the query tab was run again after the error the AI fix was written for, so the outdated fix is not applied.

fix_tab_closed.value: 失败的标签已关闭——使用 插入 将修复放入当前编辑器。
fix_tab_closed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI error fix: notice shown when the user applies an AI fix but the query tab where the original error happened has since been closed.

no_active_query.value: 没有活动的查询标签可供分析。
no_active_query.location: Workbench → Status bar → Analyze Last Run with AI: hint shown when the command is run with no query tab open, so there is no query run to analyze.

no_recent_error.value: 没有最近的查询错误可供解释。
no_recent_error.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explain Last Error (AI): hint shown when the command is run but no query has failed recently, so there is no error to explain.

object_not_loaded.value: {name} 尚未在资源管理器中加载；刷新模式后重试
object_not_loaded.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel object link: notice shown when the user clicks a schema object named in an AI answer but it is not loaded in the Explorer tree; {name} is the object name.

object_revealed.value: 在资源管理器中显示了 {name}
object_revealed.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel object link: confirmation after clicking a schema object named in an AI answer opens the Explorer and selects that object; {name} is the object name.

run_query_first.value: 先运行查询，然后用 AI 分析它。
run_query_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → Analyze Last Run with AI: hint shown when the active query tab has never been run, asking the user to run the query before asking the AI to analyze it.

select_sql_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → Send Selection to AI: hint shown when the command is run with no text selected in the query editor; asks the user to select some SQL first.

sql_inserted.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel: confirmation after the user clicks Insert on SQL in an AI answer and it is inserted at the cursor of the active query editor.

sql_opened_flagged_offset.value: 打开 SQL 并将光标放在标记的位置
sql_opened_flagged_offset.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel validation issue: confirmation after clicking a flagged issue under AI-generated SQL opens that SQL in a new query tab with the cursor on the problem position.

sql_opened_new_query.location: Workbench → Status bar → AI panel: confirmation after the user chooses to open SQL from an AI answer in a new query tab.

truncated_sql_comment.location: AI panel → Ask → Prompt box: SQL comment appended to the selected SQL sent by “Send Selection to AI” when the selection exceeds 4,000 characters, marking that the SQL was cut off.

empty.location: Query tab → AI summary strip: placeholder text in the one-line summary band above the results when AI summaries are enabled but no summary of the query has been generated yet.

update_button.location: Query tab → AI summary strip: small button at the end of the summary band that regenerates the short and long AI summaries of the current query text.

account_not_signed_in.value: {name} 使用的 Azure 账户未在此设备上登录 — 打开“管理 Entra 账户”并点击“添加用户”。
account_not_signed_in.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: error shown when the Microsoft Entra account linked to a connection is not registered in SQLLY; {name} is the connection name.

browser_unavailable.value: 浏览器预览中不可用 Azure SQL 连接 — 这是一个标签页内演示。请使用桌面应用。
browser_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Azure SQL Connection: notice shown when the command is used in the browser build, where Azure (Microsoft Entra) sign-in is not available.

connecting.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: progress message while connecting to an Azure SQL database chosen from discovered servers; {name} is “server/database”.

discovered.value: 发现 {count} 个 Azure SQL 数据库。
discovered.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: success message after scanning the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts; {count} is the number of Azure SQL databases found.

discovering.value: 正在发现 Azure SQL 服务器…
discovering.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: progress message while SQLLY searches the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts for Azure SQL servers and databases.

discovery_failed.value: 无法获取 Azure SQL 服务器。
discovery_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: error shown when searching the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts for Azure SQL servers failed and nothing was found.

discovery_permission_error.value: SQLLY 无法列出您的 Azure SQL 服务器 — 您的账户可能没有权限枚举它们。您仍然可以通过输入服务器名称来连接。
discovery_permission_error.location: Connection management dialog and connection editor → Azure SQL servers list: inline error shown when Azure SQL discovery fails, typically because the signed-in account lacks permission to list servers.

firewall_connect_first.value:
首先连接到 Azure SQL 服务器，然后再次运行此命令。

在连接栏中查找服务器名称，并确认其以 `.database.windows.net`（Azure SQL 数据库）或 `.database.azure.com`（Azure SQL 托管实例）结尾。
firewall_connect_first.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → No connection message: message shown when the Tools menu command is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to the Azure SQL server first.

firewall_contacting.value:
正在联系 Azure，将您的公共客户端 IP 添加到服务器防火墙以供 {server} 使用。

这需要绑定到活动配置文件的 Microsoft Entra (Azure) 帐户以及可刷新的访问令牌；如果缺少其中任何一项，结果将指导您采取正确的下一步操作。
firewall_contacting.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Pending message: pending message shown while SQLLY contacts Azure to add the current IP address to the server firewall; {server} is the server host name.

firewall_not_azure.value:
活动服务器 {server} 不是 Azure SQL 端点。

防火墙规则流程仅适用于托管在 Azure 的服务器（例如 *.database.windows.net）。在 SQL Server/本地环境中，客户端 IP 规则存在于防火墙产品本身或服务器的网络配置中。
firewall_not_azure.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Not Azure SQL message: message shown when the active connection is not an Azure SQL server, so no firewall rule can be added; {server} is the server host name.

firewall_preview_unavailable.value: 仅供示例——网页预览无法访问 Azure 以添加防火墙规则。请使用桌面应用程序将您的 IP 地址添加到 Azure SQL 服务器的防火墙中。
firewall_preview_unavailable.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Browser preview unavailable message: message shown in the standalone browser preview, where changing Azure firewall rules is not possible.

firewall_served_unavailable.value: 浏览器中的 SQLLY 无法添加 Azure 防火墙规则。请让您的管理员允许 SQLLY 连接的服务器。
firewall_served_unavailable.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Served browser unavailable message: message shown in the browser version served by a relay proxy or SQLLY Embedded, where changing Azure firewall rules is not possible.

firewall_title.value: 将我的 IP 添加到防火墙
firewall_title.location: Add My IP to Firewall output window → Title bar: window title shared by every result of the Tools menu command that adds the user's current IP address to an Azure SQL server firewall.

firewall_web_unavailable.value: 网页预览无法访问 Azure 以添加防火墙规则。
firewall_web_unavailable.location: Server Firewall Is Blocking Your IP dialog → Result: message shown after clicking Add Firewall Rule in the browser version, where the rule cannot be created.

minting_cloud_token.value: 正在为 {name} 创建云登录令牌…
minting_cloud_token.location: Workbench → Status bar → Cloud IAM connect: progress message while SQLLY obtains a cloud IAM access token before connecting; {name} is the connection name.

no_servers.value: 未找到 Azure SQL 服务器。
no_servers.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL discovery: notice shown when discovery finished without errors but the signed-in Microsoft Entra accounts have no Azure SQL servers.

password_load_failed.value: 无法加载 SQL 帐户密码：{error}
password_load_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Connect: error shown when the saved password for a connection cannot be read from the system credential store before connecting; {error} is the underlying error text.

session_expired.value: 您用于 {name} 的 Azure 会话已过期——请打开管理 Entra 帐户并点击添加用户重新登录。
session_expired.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: error shown when the Microsoft Entra sign-in for a connection has expired and the user must sign in again; {name} is the connection name.

sign_in_before_discovery.value: 在选择 Azure SQL 服务器之前，请先登录 Microsoft Entra 帐户。
sign_in_before_discovery.location: Connection management dialog and connection editor → Azure SQL servers list: message shown when no Microsoft Entra account is signed in, so Azure SQL servers cannot be discovered.

signing_in.location: Workbench → Status bar → Azure SQL connect: progress message while SQLLY obtains a fresh Microsoft Entra access token for a connection; {name} is the connection name.

batch_insert_unavailable.value: 此版本中不可用批量插入。
batch_insert_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid context menu → Batch Insert: notice shown when Batch Insert is chosen in the browser build, where the batch insert dialog is not available.

manual_close_hint.value: 您的浏览器只允许您自己关闭此标签页 — 使用 ⌘W（Mac）或 Ctrl+W。
manual_close_hint.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → close-tab notification: message shown after the browser refuses a scripted tab close and the user must use the browser keyboard shortcut.

result_snapshots_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Result Snapshots: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the feature.

connected_plural.value: 已连接到中继代理“{relay}”：{count} 个连接可用（只读）。
connected_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page first connects to the relay proxy, plural form; {relay} is the relay name, {count} the number of read-only connections offered.

connected_singular.value: 已连接到中继代理“{relay}”：{count} 个连接可用（只读）。
connected_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page first connects to the relay proxy, singular form used when exactly one read-only connection is offered; {relay} is the relay name.

connecting.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: progress message shown at page load while the browser version opens its session with the configured relay proxy.

license_confirmed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: success message after the proxy confirms its license; {message} is the preceding “Connected to relay proxy …” sentence.

license_paused.value: {relay}：{message} 查询已暂停，直到许可证确认。
license_paused.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy license: error when the proxy's license cannot be confirmed and queries are blocked; {relay} is the relay name, {message} the license problem.

license_warning.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy license: warning shown when the proxy reports a license problem but still serves queries; {relay} is the relay name, {message} the license problem.

reconnect_failed.value: 无法重新连接到中继代理 ({reason})。请重新加载页面以重新连接。
reconnect_failed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: error shown after all automatic reconnect attempts to the relay proxy failed; {reason} is the last failure reason. Tells the user to reload the page.

reconnected_plural.value: 已重新连接到中继代理“{relay}”：{count} 个连接可用（只读）。
reconnected_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page reconnects to the relay proxy following a dropped session, plural form; {relay} is the relay name, {count} the number of connections.

reconnected_singular.value: 已重新连接到中继代理“{relay}”：{count} 个连接可用（只读）。
reconnected_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: message after the page reconnects to the relay proxy following a dropped session, singular form for exactly one read-only connection; {relay} is the relay name.

reconnecting.value: 中继代理无法访问 ({reason})。正在重新连接…
reconnecting.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning shown when the relay proxy cannot be reached or the session dropped, as automatic reconnect attempts begin; {reason} is why it failed.

refusal_status.value: {message} 请重新加载页面以重试。
refusal_status.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: error shown when the proxy refuses the session (token, seat or license problem); {message} is the proxy's reason, followed by advice to reload the page.

session_closed.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: default reason shown in the reconnect messages when an established proxy session ends and the proxy gave no reason of its own.

still_unreachable_plural.value: 中继代理仍然无法访问 ({reason})。还有 {count} 次尝试…
still_unreachable_plural.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning after a failed reconnect attempt, plural form; {reason} is the failure reason and {count} the number of attempts remaining.

still_unreachable_singular.value: 中继代理仍然无法访问 ({reason})。还有 {count} 次尝试…
still_unreachable_singular.location: Browser version → Status bar → Relay proxy: warning after a failed reconnect attempt, singular form used when exactly one attempt remains; {reason} is the failure reason.

connect_script.value: 连接到数据库以生成所选项的脚本
connect_script.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection actions: hint shown when a bulk script, export or maintenance action has no connection to run against; asks the user to connect first.

connection_missing.value: 所选对象的连接不再存在
connection_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection actions: error shown when the selected objects belong to a saved connection that no longer exists (for example it was deleted), so the bulk action is cancelled.

export_databases_skipped.value: 导出数据一次只处理一个数据库 — {count} 选择中的其他数据库已被忽略
export_databases_skipped.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: warning that the export dialog handles one database, so only the first was used; {count} is the number of other databases skipped.

export_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase.

maintenance_scripted.value: 维护已脚本到新标签页 — 在运行前请检查
maintenance_scripted.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Maintenance: confirmation after the maintenance script for all selected objects is opened in a new query tab for review.

maintenance_scripted_skipped.value: 维护已脚本到新标签页；跳过 {objects}
maintenance_scripted_skipped.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Maintenance: confirmation after the maintenance script opens in a new tab, listing objects left out because the operation does not apply to them; {objects} is a comma-separated list.

no_tables_to_export.value: 视图没有可导出的行 — 至少选择一个表
no_tables_to_export.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Export data: notice shown when the selection contains no tables or views whose data could be exported.

script_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: error when generating the scripts fails; {verb} is the SQL keyword CREATE or DROP, {error} the error text.

script_opened.value: {verb} 脚本已在新标签页中打开 — 在运行前请检查
script_opened.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: confirmation that the generated script opened in a new query tab with no warnings; {verb} is the keyword CREATE or DROP.

script_opened_one_warning.value: {verb} 脚本已在新标签页中打开 — 在运行前请检查 (1 警告: {warning})
script_opened_one_warning.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: script opened in a new tab with exactly one warning; {verb} is CREATE or DROP, {warning} the warning text.

script_opened_warnings.value: {verb} 脚本在新标签中打开 — 在运行前请查看（{count} 警告 — 请查看脚本头部）
script_opened_warnings.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: script opened in a new tab with several warnings; {verb} is CREATE or DROP, {count} the number of warnings.

scripting.value: 正在为 {count} 对象编写 {verb} 脚本…
scripting.location: Workbench → Status bar → Explorer multi-selection → Script CREATE or Script DROP: progress message while scripts are generated; {verb} is the SQL keyword CREATE or DROP, {count} the number of selected objects.

action_unsupported.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: generic notice shown when the chosen cell action (such as a server SQL function) does not apply to the clicked column; {column} is the column name.

connect_to_view.value: 连接到数据库以查看完整值。
connect_to_view.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: hint shown when the user asks to view or copy the full value of a truncated cell with no active connection, which is needed to re-read it.

copied_full_value.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: confirmation after the full, untruncated cell value was fetched from the server and copied to the clipboard; {size} is its size, such as “2.4 MiB”.

expression_not_editable.value: {column} 不是可编辑表的列（是表达式或计算值）；请编辑行
expression_not_editable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when a cell action targets a result column computed by an expression, not a real table column; {column} is the result column name.

load_file_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: error shown when the chosen file cannot be read into the binary cell; {error} is the system error text.

load_file_unavailable.value: 从文件加载在此版本中不可用。
load_file_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: notice shown because loading a cell value from a local file is not supported in the browser build.

no_default.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set DEFAULT: notice shown when the clicked column has no default value defined; {column} is the column name.

no_key_column.value: 此结果没有关键列；请编辑行
no_key_column.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when a cell action cannot stage an edit because the result has no primary or unique key column to identify the row; suggests the row editor.

not_binary.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Load from file: notice shown when the clicked column is not a binary column that can take file contents; {column} is the column name.

not_binary_or_text.value: 该单元格既不是二进制也不是文本
not_binary_or_text.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: reason inserted into the save-failed message when the cell holds neither binary data nor text, so it cannot be written to a file.

not_editable_text.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transforms (uppercase, trim and so on): notice shown when the column is not an editable text column; {column} is the column name.

not_nullable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set NULL: notice shown when the clicked column does not allow NULL values; {column} is the column name.

not_temporal.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set to server time or Set to current timestamp: notice shown when the clicked column is not a date or time column; {column} is the column name.

not_uuid.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Set to new UUID: notice shown when the clicked column cannot store a UUID value; {column} is the column name.

nothing_to_transform.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transform: notice that applying the transform would not change the cell; {transform} is the transform name (e.g. “Trim whitespace”), {column} the column name.

original_unreadable.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: reason inserted into the save-failed message when the cell's original value could not be read back from the row.

read_failed.value: 无法读取完整的单元格值。
read_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: notice shown when SQLLY re-reads the row to fetch a truncated cell's full value but the column is missing from the re-read row.

results_changed_before_staging.value: 在编辑被暂存之前，结果已更改。请刷新并重试。
results_changed_before_staging.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu: notice shown when the query was re-run while a cell action was being prepared, so the edit was not staged; asks the user to refresh and retry.

save_file_failed.value: 无法将单元格保存到文件：{error}
save_file_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: error shown when writing the cell value to the chosen file fails; {error} is the reason.

save_file_unavailable.value: 保存到文件在此版本中不可用。
save_file_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → Save to file: notice shown because saving a cell value to a local file is not supported in the browser build.

staged_expression.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid cell context menu → text transform: notice that the cell already has a staged SQL expression (for example a server function), so a text transform cannot be applied; {column} is the column name.

text_rejected.location: Workbench → Status bar: shown when text applied in the Cell Details panel is not valid for the column; {column} is the column name and {error} the reason, such as “Enter a whole number.”

viewer_limit_exceeded.value: 该值超过了 {limit} 查看器的限制。
viewer_limit_exceeded.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results grid truncated cell: notice shown when the full value is larger than the size the cell viewer can load, so it is not fetched; a {limit} size value is available to this message.

connect_before_save.value: 在将图表保存到库之前，请先连接到数据库
connect_before_save.location: Workbench → Status bar → Results Chart tab → Save chart to library: hint shown when the user saves a chart with no active connection; a saved chart must be tied to a connection.

connection_missing.value: 图表 "{name}" 的连接 "{connection}" 不再存在
connection_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar → Tools menu → Saved Charts: error when a saved chart cannot be opened because its connection no longer exists; {connection} is the connection name, {name} the chart name.

dashboard_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Chart Dashboard: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the dashboard.

save_prompt_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Results → Save Chart to Library: message shown because the saved-chart library is unavailable.

saved_status.value: 已将图表 "{name}" 保存到库中 — 可通过工具 > 已保存图表 打开
saved_status.location: Workbench → Status bar → Save Chart dialog: confirmation after a chart is saved to the chart library, telling the user where to find it; {name} is the chart name. Keep the menu path matching the translated Tools menu.

saved_unavailable.location: Browser version → Status bar → Tools menu → Saved Charts: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” notice; should read as a short noun phrase naming the saved charts library.

ai_catalog_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when the Build AI Cache and Embeddings or Clear AI Catalog Data command is run; names the feature that the browser build does not support.

ai_quit_description.value: 现在退出将会停止运行并丢弃未完成的答案。选择等待以继续工作，或选择仍然退出以退出。
ai_quit_description.location: Quit confirmation dialog → AI run in progress: body text shown when the user quits SQLLY while the AI Assistant is still answering; explains that quitting discards the partial answer and names the Wait and Quit anyway buttons.

ai_quit_title.location: Quit confirmation dialog → AI run in progress: dialog title shown when the user quits SQLLY (Cmd+Q or the Quit menu item) while an AI Assistant request is still running.

already_detached.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Detach Results to Window is run on a query tab whose results are already open in a separate results window; nothing else happens.

cleanup_start_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown after the user confirms deleting all app data but the cleanup job could not be scheduled; {error} is the system error text.

cleanup_task_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when the background step that removes stored Microsoft Entra sign-in tokens crashed before finishing; {error} is the internal failure text.

clear_entra_credentials_failed.value: 无法清除已存储的凭据；未删除任何文件：{error}
clear_entra_credentials_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when stored Microsoft Entra (Azure) sign-in tokens could not be removed, so the reset was abandoned before any files were deleted; {error} is the keychain error.

clear_sql_credentials_failed.value: 无法清除已存储的 SQL 凭据；未删除任何文件：{error}
clear_sql_credentials_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when saved SQL login passwords could not be removed from the keychain, so the reset was abandoned before any files were deleted; {error} is the keychain error.

connect_before_catalog_refresh.value: 在刷新目录之前先连接到服务器
connect_before_catalog_refresh.location: Workbench → Status bar: hint shown when Refresh IntelliSense Catalog is run with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a server first.

date_refreshed.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when exactly one natural-language date comment in the editor was recalculated (singular form).

dates_current.value: 自然语言日期已经是最新的
dates_current.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when no natural-language date comment in the editor needed recalculating.

dates_refreshed.location: Workbench → Status bar: result of the Refresh Natural-Language Dates command when several natural-language date comments were recalculated; {count} is the number of dates updated (two or more).

delete_all_cancel.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Cancel button: default cancel button that closes the alert and keeps all data; answers the question “Delete all SQLLY data?”.

delete_all_confirm.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Confirm button: destructive confirm button that wipes every SQLLY setting, connection, credential and unsaved query and then closes the app.

delete_all_description.value: 我们将永久删除与此应用相关的所有数据，然后关闭 SQLLY。任何未保存的查询将被删除。下次打开 SQLLY 时，它将恢复到出厂状态。这是不可撤销的。
delete_all_description.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Message body: explanatory body text opened from Settings → Advanced → Clear all data, warning that the reset is permanent, deletes unsaved queries and quits the app.

delete_all_failed.value: 无法删除所有应用数据：{error}
delete_all_failed.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar: error shown when the app data files could not be scheduled for deletion after confirmation; {error} is the file-system error text.

delete_all_title.value: 删除所有 SQLLY 数据？
delete_all_title.location: Delete all SQLLY data confirmation (system alert) → Alert title: title of the critical alert opened from Settings → Advanced → Clear all data, asking whether to erase all app data.

deploy_cart_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when the Deploy Cart command is run; names the Deploy Cart tool, which only exists in the desktop app.

detach_browser_unavailable.value: 浏览器预览中无法分离结果
detach_browser_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when Detach Results to Window is run, because the browser build cannot open a second window.

detach_query_tabs_only.value: 只有查询标签可以被分离
detach_query_tabs_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Detach Results to Window is run on a notebook tab or a DDL viewer tab; only regular query tabs can move their results into a separate window.

detached_status.value: 结果已分离 — 关闭窗口或按重新附加以将其带回
detached_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after a query tab's results open in their own window; tells the user that closing that window or pressing the Re-attach button returns them to the tab.

detached_window_title.location: Detached results window → Title bar: window title bar text for results moved out of a query tab; {tab} is the name of the query tab the results belong to.

external_editor_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Open in External Editor fails to launch the configured editor or read the edited file back; {error} is the reason.

external_editor_updated.value: 编辑器内容已从外部编辑器更新
external_editor_updated.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after the user closes the external editor opened by Open in External Editor and the edited SQL replaces the query editor's text.

focus_notebook_cell.location: Notebook tab → Status bar: hint shown when Run Notebook Cell is used while no notebook cell has keyboard focus; asks the user to click into a cell first.

multi_target_proc_mode.value: 在过程模式下无法在多个连接上运行
multi_target_proc_mode.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Run on Multiple Connections is chosen while the active query tab is in procedure mode, where running on several connections is not supported.

multi_target_requires_connection.value: 先添加一个连接 — “在多个连接上运行”会从已保存的连接中选择
multi_target_requires_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar: hint shown when Run on Multiple Connections is chosen but no connections are saved yet; the target picker only lists saved connections.

no_connection_to_disconnect.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when the Disconnect command is run in a window that has no active connection.

no_statements.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Run Statements… is invoked but the query editor is empty or contains no runnable SQL statements, so the statement picker does not open.

not_production.value: 活动连接未标记为生产
not_production.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when an Unlock Production Writes command is run but the active connection is not flagged as a production connection, so there is nothing to unlock.

preferences_saved.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after the user saves changes in the Settings window and the new preferences are applied to the open windows.

production_lock_expired.location: Workbench → production write unlock timer: status shown when the temporary unlock expires and writes become locked again.

production_lock_no_active_connection.location: Workbench → Unlock Production Writes command: status shown when there is no active connection whose production setting can be checked.

production_locked.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after Lock Production Writes Now ends a temporary unlock, so writes on the production connection need confirmation again.

quick_action_unconfigured.value: 槽 {slot} 没有配置快速操作
quick_action_unconfigured.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when a quick-action shortcut is pressed for a slot that has no action assigned; {slot} is the slot number (1–9).

refreshing_catalog.value: 正在刷新 IntelliSense 目录…
refreshing_catalog.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message shown while Refresh IntelliSense Catalog reloads table, column and routine names from the active connection for autocompletion.

reset_app_data_browser_hint.value: {notice}（浏览器数据可以通过浏览器的站点数据设置清除）
reset_app_data_browser_hint.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar (browser build): error shown instead of resetting; {notice} is the complete browser-preview notice, followed by where to clear browser site data.

reset_app_data_unavailable.location: Delete all SQLLY data → Status bar (browser build): clause saying the app-data reset is unavailable, inserted as {feature} into the browser-preview notice that becomes {notice} in the reset error.

results_window_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when Detach Results to Window could not create the separate results window; the results stay in the query tab.

run_all_notebook_cells_requires_notebook.location: Workbench → Run All Notebook Cells command or action: status shown when no notebook is open.

run_notebook_cell_requires_notebook.location: Workbench → Run Notebook Cell command or action: status shown when no notebook is open.

save_notebook_required.location: Workbench → Save Notebook command or action: status shown when no notebook is open to save.

single_browser_window.value: 浏览器版本只有一个窗口。
single_browser_window.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when Move Tab to New Window is run, because the browser build has only one window.

unknown_command.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a menu item, shortcut or palette entry triggers a command id SQLLY does not recognize; {command_id} is that internal id, left untranslated.

unlocked_fifteen_minutes.value: 生产写入已解锁 15 分钟
unlocked_fifteen_minutes.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after Unlock Production Writes for 15 Minutes; writes on the production connection run without the extra confirmation for 15 minutes.

unlocked_five_minutes.value: 生产写入已解锁 5 分钟
unlocked_five_minutes.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after Unlock Production Writes for 5 Minutes; writes on the production connection run without the extra confirmation for 5 minutes.

unlocked_one_minute.value: 生产写入已解锁 1 分钟
unlocked_one_minute.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after Unlock Production Writes for 1 Minute; writes on the production connection run without the extra confirmation for one minute.

active_connection_connecting.location: Workbench → active-connection completion path: busy status shown after authentication while databases are still being enumerated; {name} is the saved connection name.

add_browser_unavailable.value: 在浏览器预览中无法添加 SQL Server 连接 — 这是一个标签内演示。请使用桌面应用。
add_browser_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown in the browser preview when the user tries to add a new connection, which the browser build cannot do; short phrase meaning adding connections is unavailable in the browser.

connecting.location: Workbench → initial connection attempt: busy status shown before authentication and connection completion; {name} is the saved connection name.

deleted.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after a connection is deleted from the Manage Connections workspace.

deleted_with_name.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after the user confirms the Delete Connection dialog; {name} is the deleted connection's name. Meaning: “Deleted connection {name}”.

disconnected.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after a server is disconnected; {name} is the connection name, or the word “server” when the name is unknown.

duplicate_not_found.location: Workbench → Duplicate Connection action: warning shown when the saved connection selected for duplication no longer exists.

entity_organization_updated.location: Workbench → Entity Management dialog: success status shown after entity organization changes are saved.

not_found.location: Workbench → Status bar: warning shown when the user asks to delete a connection that no longer exists in the saved connections list.

opening_relay.value: 正在打开到 {name} 的中继…
opening_relay.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message shown while SQLLY opens a remote Via-Relay session to a bridged server; {name} is the connection name.

organization_updated.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after folders, groups or other organization of saved connections changes in the Manage Connections workspace.

proxy_read_only.value: 这些连接是在 SQLLY 运行的服务器上设置的，并且在此处是只读的。请您的管理员添加或更改一项。
proxy_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when the user tries to add, duplicate, delete or import connections while they are provided by a relay proxy; the connection list is read-only.

quick_switch_missing.value: 在选择器中未找到连接 #{number}
quick_switch_missing.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when a quick-switch connection shortcut is pressed but there is no saved connection at that position; {number} is the shortcut's position number.

relay_device_unregistered.value: 此设备尚未在您的 SQLLY 帐户中注册。
relay_device_unregistered.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when opening a Via-Relay connection while this device has not been registered with the user's SQLLY account.

relay_key_failed.value: 无法加载此设备的中继安全密钥。
relay_key_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when opening a Via-Relay connection fails because this device's encryption key could not be loaded or created.

relay_lost.value: 中继连接已丢失——桥接已断开。
relay_lost.location: Explorer → Server node and Status bar: error shown, and stored as the server's last failure reason, when an open Via-Relay session to a remote server drops.

relay_sign_in_required.value: 登录到您的 SQLLY 帐户以打开中继连接。
relay_sign_in_required.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when opening a Via-Relay connection without a valid SQLLY account sign-in; the user must sign in first.

relay_task_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the background task opening a Via-Relay connection stopped unexpectedly before the session was set up.

resume_declined.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after the user cancels the Resume Connection dialog; the query runs on the current connection instead of switching to the one remembered with the tab.

resume_not_found.value: 恢复：在已保存的连接中未找到连接 {server}/{database}
resume_not_found.location: Workbench → Status bar: warning shown when a restored query tab remembers a server/database but no saved connection matches it; {server} is the remembered server name, the current connection is kept.

resume_not_found_default_database.location: Workbench → remembered-connection resume: database value substituted in the not-found warning when the remembered connection has no explicit database.

resumed.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after a restored query tab reconnects to the server it remembered; {server} is that server's name.

resumed_default_database.location: Workbench → remembered-connection resume: database value substituted in the success status when the remembered connection has no explicit database.

saved.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after the user saves the connection editor dialog (new or edited connection).

saved_with_name.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after a connection is saved from the Manage Connections workspace; {name} is the saved connection's name. Meaning: “Saved connection {name}”.

server_fallback.location: Workbench → Status bar: lowercase generic word inserted in place of a connection name in disconnect and connection-failure messages when the connection's name cannot be found.

active_connection.location: Workbench → Object Explorer → custom action parameter prompt: fallback target description when no server, database, or object name is available.

connect.value: 连接到数据库以运行自定义操作
connect.location: Explorer → Context menu → Custom Actions: status-bar hint shown when a custom action is chosen but there is neither a target nor an active connection to run it on; asks the user to connect.

review_detail.value: 自定义操作“{name}”将运行此 SQL。它不是只读的，因此仅在您确认后运行。
review_detail.location: SQLLY → Custom Actions: text shown as “Custom action “{name}” will run this SQL. It is not read-only, so it runs only after you confirm.”.

review_status.location: Explorer → Context menu → Custom Actions: status-bar message shown when a custom action's generated SQL must be reviewed in the confirmation panel before it runs; {name} is the custom action's name.

running.location: Explorer → Context menu → Custom Actions: status-bar message shown when a custom action's SQL is opened in a new tab and run immediately; {name} is the custom action's name.

scripted.value: “{name}”已编写到新标签页 — 运行前请审查
scripted.location: Explorer → Context menu → Custom Actions: status-bar message shown when a script-only custom action writes its SQL into a new query tab without running it; {name} is the custom action's name.

template_missing.location: Explorer → Context menu → Custom Actions: status-bar warning shown when the chosen custom action's template no longer exists in the user's template library; {name} is the template name.

ambiguous_symbol.location: SQL editor → Go to definition: status-bar error shown when the clicked name matches several database objects; {name} is the clicked name and {candidates} is a comma-separated list of the matching qualified names.

connect_model_definition.value: 连接到数据库以打开数据模型定义
connect_model_definition.location: Open Project File dialog → Data-model object: status-bar hint shown when the user opens an object's definition with no active connection; asks the user to connect so the DDL can be generated.

connect_navigation.value: 连接到数据库以导航到 DDL
connect_navigation.location: SQL editor → Go to definition: status-bar hint shown when the user jumps to an object's definition with no active connection; asks the user to connect first.

fetch_failed_status.location: DDL viewer → Status bar: error shown when generating an object's definition (CREATE script) from the server fails; {error} is the server or driver error message.

fetch_failed_viewer.location: DDL viewer → Body: error text shown inside the viewer instead of the definition when fetching the object's CREATE script fails; {error} is the server or driver error message.

fetching.location: DDL viewer → Status bar: busy message shown while SQLLY fetches the definition of the object being navigated to; {object} is its schema-qualified name.

loaded.location: DDL viewer → Status bar: success message shown once an object's definition finishes loading into the DDL viewer; {title} is the viewer's title (for example “DDL: dbo.Orders”).

model_fetching.location: Workbench → project-file data-model object → DDL viewer: busy status while the selected object definition is fetched; {object} is the qualified database object name.

model_viewer_title.location: Workbench → project-file data-model object → DDL viewer tab: title for the selected object definition; {object} is the qualified database object name.

no_navigable_object.value: 光标下没有可导航的数据库对象
no_navigable_object.location: SQL editor → Go to definition: status-bar message shown when the name under the cursor does not match any table, view, routine or type in the IntelliSense catalog.

no_viewer.location: Open Project File dialog → Data-model object: status-bar message shown when the chosen object is a trigger, index or unknown kind that has no definition viewer; {kind} is the object type label.

unavailable.location: DDL viewer → Status bar: warning shown when the definition loaded but the server could not produce a CREATE script for the object; {title} is the viewer's title.

viewer_title.location: DDL viewer → Tab, panel or popup title: title shown on the viewer tab, side panel or popup that displays an object's CREATE script; {object} is the object's schema-qualified name.

connect_url_failed.value: 无法通过连接 URL 连接：{error}
connect_url_failed.location: Workbench status bar → deep-link handling: error shown when a connection URL passed to SQLLY at startup cannot be turned into a connection; {error} is the technical reason.

open_failed.location: Workbench status bar → deep-link handling: error shown when an incoming SQLLY link cannot be parsed or opened; {error} is the technical parser error.

query_opened.value: 已从链接打开查询 — 在运行前请检查
query_opened.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after a sqlly:// query link from outside the app opens its SQL in a new query tab on the named connection.

cancel_button.location: Delete Connection dialog → Footer buttons (cancel): secondary button that closes the dialog and keeps the saved connection.

delete_button.location: Delete Connection dialog → Footer buttons (delete): red destructive confirm button that permanently removes the saved connection.

environment_label.location: Delete Connection dialog → Details: row label (followed by a colon) in front of the connection's environment tag, such as Production or Development.

prompt.location: Delete Connection dialog → Confirmation prompt: main question text at the top of the dialog body; {name} is the saved connection's name shown in quotation marks.

server_label.location: Delete Connection dialog → Details: row label (followed by a colon) in front of the server host name of the connection about to be deleted.

title.location: Delete Connection dialog → Title bar: dialog title shown when the user chooses to delete a saved connection from the explorer or the connection list.

warning.value: 这将删除已保存的配置文件、其凭据绑定及其安全功能。此操作无法撤销。数据库本身不受影响。
warning.location: Delete Connection dialog → Warning caption: small dimmed caution line under the confirmation question, above the Server and Environment details; a one-word warning heading.

added.value: 已将 {object} 添加到部署清单 “{cart}”
added.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart → Add to Deploy Cart: status-bar success message; {object} is the added object's name and {cart} is the active deploy cart's name. Meaning: “Added {object} to {cart}”.

data_included.value: “{cart}” 中的 {object} 现在包含数据
data_included.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart → Add with Data: status-bar message when an object already in the cart is upgraded to include its row data; {object} is the object, {cart} the cart name.

duplicate.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart: status-bar message when the chosen object is already in the active cart, so nothing changes; {object} is the object, {cart} the cart name.

failed.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart: status-bar error shown when adding an object to the active deploy cart could not be saved; {error} is the reason.

unsupported_object.value: 此对象无法添加到部署清单
unsupported_object.location: Explorer → Context menu → Deploy Cart: status-bar warning shown when the right-clicked object type cannot be added to a deploy cart.

ddl_split_unavailable.value: DDL 查看器选项卡无法拆分成两个视图
ddl_split_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when the user tries to split the editor while a read-only DDL viewer tab is active; DDL viewers cannot be split.

format_shortcut_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Format SQL icon button: tooltip when a keyboard shortcut is assigned; {shortcut} is the key combination (for example ⌘⇧F). Reformats the current query.

format_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Format SQL icon button: tooltip shown when no keyboard shortcut is assigned to formatting; the button reformats the current query.

gesture_zoom_status.location: Workbench → editor trackpad or touch gesture: status showing the updated zoom percentage in {percent}.

refresh_schema_age_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Refresh schema icon button: tooltip when a cached schema exists; {age} is how long ago it was fetched (for example “5 minutes ago”). Reloads the object explorer and IntelliSense catalog.

refresh_schema_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Refresh schema icon button: tooltip shown when no cached schema exists yet for the connection; the button reloads the object explorer and IntelliSense catalog.

save_shortcut_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Save icon button: tooltip when a keyboard shortcut is assigned; {shortcut} is the key combination (for example ⌘S). Saves the current query to a file.

save_tooltip.location: Query command bar → Save icon button: tooltip shown when no keyboard shortcut is assigned to saving; the button saves the current query to a file.

zoom_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after the editor zoom level is changed with the zoom slider, zoom shortcuts or Reset Zoom; reports the new zoom level as a percentage.

new_query_button.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): button below the shortcut hint that opens a new blank query tab.

new_query_shortcut.value: 按 {shortcut} 打开一个新查询窗口。
new_query_shortcut.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): dimmed hint under the “No query open” heading; {shortcut} is the key combination for New Query (for example ⌘N).

no_query.location: Workbench → Empty state (no tabs open): large heading under the SQLLY logo shown when every query tab has been closed.

agent_grant_mismatch.value: 代理写入权限不匹配 — 未执行任何操作
agent_grant_mismatch.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when SQL proposed by the AI assistant or an MCP agent no longer matches the write approval it was granted (edited text or different connection), so the run was refused and nothing executed.

ai_review_ready_run.value: AI 审核已准备好 — 确认运行
ai_review_ready_run.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the required AI review of a data-changing query has finished, telling the user to confirm in the data-change review dialog to run the query.

ai_review_ready_save.value: AI 审核已准备好 — 确认保存
ai_review_ready_save.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the required AI review of staged grid edits has finished, telling the user to confirm in the review dialog to save the changes to the database.

ai_review_unavailable.value: AI 审核不可用 — 查询未运行：{error}
ai_review_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the AI review required before a data change could not be generated, so the pending review is dropped and the query is not run; {error} is the AI provider’s error text.

auto_refresh_disabled_not_select.value: 自动刷新已关闭：最后一个语句不是仅 SELECT
auto_refresh_disabled_not_select.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a query tab’s auto-refresh timer fires on SQL whose last statement changes data, so auto-refresh is switched off for that tab instead of re-running it.

auto_refresh_multi_target.value: 自动刷新不在多个目标上运行
auto_refresh_multi_target.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a query tab with auto-refresh turned on is run on several connections at once; auto-refresh only works with a single connection.

confirm_mutation.location: Workbench → Status bar: short info prompt shown when a single-connection query that changes data opens the data-change review dialog (no AI review required); asks the user to confirm or cancel the change.

count_cte_unsupported.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on a query starting with a WITH common table expression, which cannot be wrapped in a COUNT query.

count_review_pending.value: 在变更审核待处理时无法计算总行数
count_review_pending.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is clicked while a data-change review for the same tab is still awaiting confirmation.

count_single_statement.value: 总数需要单个 SELECT 语句
count_single_statement.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on SQL containing more than one statement; counting requires exactly one SELECT.

generating_ai_review.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy progress message shown after a single-connection data-changing query opens the review dialog while the required AI explanation of the change is being generated.

log_cancelled.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when the running query reports that it was cancelled; standalone past-participle status, one word in English.

log_completed.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a query finishes on the server; {milliseconds} is the elapsed execution time in milliseconds.

log_database_changed.value: 数据库上下文已更改为 {database}
log_database_changed.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a statement (such as USE) switches the session’s current database; {database} is the new database name.

log_default_database.location: Workbench → execution log: database value substituted in the query-start entry when the active connection has no explicit database.

log_executing.value: 在 {server}/{database} 上执行 {count} 个字符
log_executing.location: Log Console (Diagnostic Log) → query category: verbose log entry written when a query is sent; {count} is the number of characters of SQL sent and {server} is the connection’s server name.

multi_target_bottom_line.location: Data-change review dialog → summary headline for a multi-connection run: {bottom_line} is the uppercase change summary (e.g. “WE WILL MAKE UPDATE CHANGES.”), {count} the number of connections, {targets} their comma-separated names.

multi_target_confirm_mutation.location: Workbench → multi-target data-change review: status asking the user to confirm the mutation across the selected connections.

multi_target_generating_ai_review.location: Workbench → multi-target data-change review: busy status while the required AI review is generated.

multi_target_manual_unavailable.value: 手动提交模式下不支持多目标运行
multi_target_manual_unavailable.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the user tries to run a query on several connections while the tab’s transaction mode is Manual commit; multi-connection runs need auto-commit.

multi_target_procedure_unavailable.value: 在过程模式下无法在多个连接上运行
multi_target_procedure_unavailable.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown when the active editor is in procedure mode.

multi_target_production_refusal.location: Workbench → Status bar: error refusing a multi-connection run because one selected production connection is read-only; {message} is the production read-only explanation, {profile} the name of that connection.

multi_target_query_cancelled.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: final summary shown when cancellation finishes without target failures.

multi_target_query_running.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: busy status while the query runs on the selected connections.

multi_target_review_pending.value: 请先确认或取消待定的变更审查
multi_target_review_pending.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown while another mutation review is pending for the tab.

multi_target_snapshot_read_only.value: SQLLY 导出标签是只读快照，无法执行查询
multi_target_snapshot_read_only.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution: refusal shown when the selected tab contains a read-only result snapshot.

multi_target_tenant_refusal_with_profile.location: Workbench → multi-target query execution → tenant safety gate: refusal annotated with the connection that rejected the statement; {message} is the localized tenant refusal and {profile} is the connection name.

mutation_cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown after the user clicks Cancel in the data-change review dialog, confirming the data-changing query was not run.

no_active_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when the user runs a query in a tab while no database connection is active; nothing is executed.

no_count_returned.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when the background COUNT query for “Calculate total rows” finished but returned no usable number.

no_valid_connections.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a multi-connection run starts but none of the chosen connections still exist in the saved connection list, so nothing runs.

not_connected.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is clicked but the workbench has no active connection to run the count on.

not_select_only.value: 不是仅限 SELECT 的语句
not_select_only.location: Results → Status bar → Total rows: generic failure message (tooltip and Messages tab line) shown when “Calculate total rows” is used on SQL that is not purely a SELECT and no more specific reason is available.

pick_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a run on multiple connections is started with an empty selection in the connection picker; asks the user to choose at least one connection.

production_read_only.value: 生产环境是只读的。请从状态栏芯片或命令面板解锁写入（1/5/15 分钟）以运行此操作。
production_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when data-changing SQL is run on a connection marked Production while writes are locked; explains how to unlock writes for 1, 5 or 15 minutes via the status-bar chip or Command Palette.

query_cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown after the user cancels the running query in the current tab, or when a run ends because it was cancelled.

query_complete.location: Workbench → Status bar: fallback success message shown when a single-connection query finishes but no elapsed time was reported, so the detailed statements/rows/seconds summary cannot be built.

query_failed_title.location: macOS system notification → title: heading of the desktop notification posted when a query fails while the SQLLY window is in the background and system notifications are enabled; the error text is the body.

query_running.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy progress message shown while a single-connection query is executing in the current tab.

result_set_label.location: Results → Result set tabs (multi-connection run): label of the second and later result sets returned by one connection; {name} is the connection name and {number} the result set’s position within that connection’s output.

resume_switch_default_database.location: Workbench → query execution resume prompt: database value substituted when the remembered connection has no explicit database.

resume_switch_prompt.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation prompt shown when the user runs a restored tab while disconnected, asking whether to reconnect to the tab’s remembered connection; {server} is the server name, {database} the database.

review_pending.value: 请先确认或取消待定的变更审查
review_pending.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the user tries to run another query in a tab whose data-change review dialog is still open; asks them to confirm or cancel that review first.

rollback_bypassed.value: 在未回滚包装下运行（仅此运行）
rollback_bypassed.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the “Execute Without Rollback Wrap” command is used on a connection that normally wraps runs in a rolled-back transaction; applies to this one run only.

row_affected_note.location: AI assistant / MCP agent → write proposal record and audit log: singular note saved when an approved agent write runs and exactly one row was changed; {rows} is the affected row count (1).

rows_affected_note.location: AI assistant / MCP agent → write proposal record and audit log: plural note saved when an approved agent write runs and zero or several rows were changed; {rows} is the affected row count.

snapshot_read_only.value: SQLLY 导出标签是只读快照，无法执行查询
snapshot_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when the user tries to run a query in a tab opened from a saved SQLLY result export, which only displays a frozen snapshot and has no connection to execute on.

summary_many_failures.value: 在 {count} 个连接上运行 — {failures} 失败
summary_many_failures.location: Workbench → Status bar: final summary after a query ran on several connections and more than one failed; {count} is the number of connections, {failures} the number that failed.

summary_many_one_failure.value: 在 {count} 连接上运行 — 1 个失败
summary_many_one_failure.location: Workbench → Status bar: final summary after a query ran on several connections and exactly one of them failed; {count} is the number of connections.

summary_many_success.location: Workbench → Status bar: final success summary after a query ran on several connections and none failed; {count} is the number of connections.

summary_one_failure.value: 在 1 个连接上运行 — 1 个失败
summary_one_failure.location: Workbench → Status bar: final error summary after a multi-connection run that targeted only one connection, which failed.

summary_one_success.location: Workbench → Status bar: final success summary after a multi-connection run that targeted only one connection and succeeded.

summary_row.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular segment for rows returned, joined by “·” with other parts (e.g. “1 statement · 1 row · 0.12 s”); {count} is 1.

summary_row_affected.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular segment for rows changed by INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, joined by “·” with other parts; {count} is 1.

summary_rows.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural segment for the number of rows the query returned, joined by “·” with other parts (e.g. “1 statement · 42 rows · 0.12 s”); {count} is the row count.

summary_rows_affected.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural segment for the number of rows changed by INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, joined by “·” with other parts; {count} is the affected row count.

summary_seconds.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: final segment giving the elapsed run time; {seconds} is the time in seconds with two decimals; keep the unit abbreviation very short.

summary_statement.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: singular first segment counting executed statements, e.g. “1 statement · 42 rows · 0.12 s”; {count} is 1.

summary_statements.location: Workbench → Status bar → run summary: plural first segment counting executed statements, e.g. “3 statements · 128 rows affected · 0.42 s”; {count} is the number of statements.

tab_closed_before_token.value: 查询标签在令牌到达前已关闭
tab_closed_before_token.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a query was waiting for a sign-in access token (Microsoft Entra ID or cloud IAM) and its tab was closed before the token arrived, so the run is dropped.

target_cancelled.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): line added when the run on one connection is cancelled; {name} is that connection’s name, shown in square brackets as a prefix.

target_completed.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): line added when the run on one connection finishes successfully; {name} is the connection name in brackets, {milliseconds} its elapsed time in milliseconds.

target_fallback.location: Results → Result set tabs (multi-connection run): label of a connection’s first result set when that connection has no display name; {number} is the connection’s position in the run (1, 2, …).

target_name.location: Results → Result set tabs and Messages tab (multi-connection run): generic noun used in place of a connection’s name when it has none, in later result-set labels and bracketed error lines.

unknown_connection_plural.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): plural note added at the start of the run when several selected connections no longer exist and were skipped; {count} is how many.

unknown_connection_singular.location: Results → Messages tab (multi-connection run): singular note added at the start of the run when one selected connection no longer exists and was skipped; {count} is 1.

waiting_for_required_ai_review.value: 等待 AI 审核 — 此连接在运行数据更改前需要审核
waiting_for_required_ai_review.location: Workbench → data-change review dialog → Execute action: informational status shown when confirmation is attempted before the required AI review has arrived.

action_alter_script.location: Workbench → Status bar → Fetching object definition: noun phrase “ALTER script” filled into {action_label} of the fetching/opened messages after Script as ALTER on a view, procedure, or function; used mid-sentence.

action_definition.location: Workbench → Status bar → Fetching object definition: lowercase noun “definition” filled into {action_label} of the fetching/opened messages after Edit Definition on a view, procedure, or function; used mid-sentence.

ai_context_pinned.value: 将 {object} 固定到 AI 上下文
ai_context_pinned.location: Object Explorer → Object context menu → Pin to AI Context: status-bar message confirming the object was pinned as context for the AI panel; {object} is the schema-qualified object name, e.g. “dbo.Orders”.

azure_linked.value: 已链接 {name} — 从其行的菜单或服务器选择器连接
azure_linked.location: Object Explorer → Azure discovered databases: status-bar success message after clicking a discovered Azure database adds it as a saved connection; {name} is the new connection name; tells the user to connect from the row's menu or the server picker.

columns_not_loaded.value: 警告：列未加载 — DDL 将为空。请先展开表节点以加载列。
columns_not_loaded.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → Clipboard: status-bar warning shown when the table's columns are not loaded yet, so the copied CREATE TABLE script would be empty; tells the user to expand the table node first.

columns_warning_sql_comment.value:
-- 警告：列未加载。请先展开表节点以加载列。
{ddl}
columns_warning_sql_comment.location: Object Explorer → Table context menu → Script As → CREATE To → New Query Window: SQL comment line inserted at the top of the generated script when the table's columns were not loaded; must stay a valid SQL comment starting with two hyphens.
