database_label.location: Resume Connection dialog → Connection details: row label for the database the restored query tab was last run against, shown under the Server row.

default_database.location: Workbench → Resume Connection dialog: database detail value shown when the remembered connection has no explicit database.

disabled_scope_tooltip.value: 查询状态恢复已禁用（范围：{scope}）。在首选项中更改范围以启用每个查询的恢复。
disabled_scope_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query toolbar → Query resume toggle: tooltip shown when the query resume scope in Settings is set to none, so the toggle is disabled; {scope} is that scope name.

disconnected_explanation.value: 您未连接。此查询上次在上述连接上运行。
disconnected_explanation.location: Resume Connection dialog → Disconnected explanation line: small dimmed explanatory line under the switch question, explaining that SQLLY is currently disconnected and the tab remembers a previous connection.

dont_ask_again.location: Resume Connection dialog → Footer: checkbox label at the left; when checked, later runs in this tab switch to the remembered connection automatically without asking.

environment_label.location: Resume Connection dialog → Connection details: row label for the environment tag (for example Production or Development) of the saved connection the tab would switch to.

following_off_tooltip.value: 为此查询保存查询状态 — 关闭（以下范围：{scope}）
following_off_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query toolbar → Query resume toggle: tooltip when saving query state is off for this tab because it follows the global scope from Settings; {scope} is that scope name.

following_on_tooltip.value: 为此查询保存查询状态 — 开启（以下范围：{scope}）
following_on_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query toolbar → Query resume toggle: tooltip when saving query state is on for this tab because it follows the global scope from Settings; {scope} is that scope name.

forced_off_tooltip.value: 为此查询保存查询状态 — 强制关闭（覆盖范围：{scope}）
forced_off_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query toolbar → Query resume toggle: tooltip when the user has turned saving query state off for this tab, overriding the global scope; {scope} is that scope name.

forced_on_tooltip.value: 为此查询保存查询状态 — 强制开启（覆盖范围：{scope}）
forced_on_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query toolbar → Query resume toggle: tooltip when the user has turned saving query state on for this tab, overriding the global scope; {scope} is that scope name.

integrated_credentials.location: Resume Connection dialog → Connection details → Credentials row: value shown when the remembered connection uses Windows/integrated authentication rather than a named login.

server_label.location: Resume Connection dialog → Connection details: first row label, for the server host name the restored query tab was last connected to.

switch_button.location: Resume Connection dialog → Footer: primary button that connects to the tab’s remembered server and database and then runs the query; verb meaning “switch over”.

switch_prompt.location: Resume Connection dialog → Switch prompt: main question shown when you run a restored query tab while disconnected; {server} is the remembered server name and {database} the remembered database.

title.location: Resume Connection dialog → Title bar: dialog title, shown when running a reopened query tab while disconnected and the tab remembers the connection it last used.

unknown_credentials.location: Workbench → Resume Connection dialog → Credentials detail: fallback shown when no saved profile can be resolved.

unknown_environment.location: Workbench → Resume Connection dialog → Environment detail: fallback shown when no saved profile can be resolved.

connect_to_copy_update.value: 连接到数据库以复制 UPDATE 语句。
connect_to_copy_update.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Results grid context menu → Copy As → SQL UPDATE is used while no database is connected; means connect first to copy the rows as UPDATE statements.

connect_to_insert.value: 连接到数据库以插入行。
connect_to_insert.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Results grid row context menu → Batch Insert is chosen while no database is connected; means connect first to insert rows.

connect_to_paste.value: 连接到数据库以粘贴行。
connect_to_paste.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when pasting (Cmd+V) clipboard rows into the Results grid while no database is connected; means connect first to paste rows into the table.

connect_to_stage_deletes.value: 连接到数据库以暂存行删除。
connect_to_stage_deletes.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when Stage Delete is chosen for several selected Results grid rows while no database is connected.

copied_update_plural.value: 已复制 {count} 条 UPDATE 语句。
copied_update_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation after Results grid → Copy As → SQL UPDATE copied several rows to the clipboard; plural form, {count} is the number of UPDATE statements copied.

copied_update_singular.value: 已复制 {count} 条 UPDATE 语句。
copied_update_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation after Results grid → Copy As → SQL UPDATE copied one row to the clipboard; singular form, {count} is 1.

saved_refresh_hint.value: 行已保存。重新运行查询以刷新网格。
saved_refresh_hint.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message after a row edit is saved when the original query is not a plain SELECT, so SQLLY does not re-run it automatically to refresh the grid.

staged_delete_plural.value: 已暂存 {count} 行以待删除。
staged_delete_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after several selected Results grid rows are marked as pending deletes (not yet saved); plural form, {count} is the number of rows.

staged_delete_singular.value: 已暂存 {count} 行以待删除。
staged_delete_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar: message after one Results grid row is marked as a pending delete (not yet saved); singular form, {count} is 1.

run_plural.location: Run Statements dialog → Footer: primary button label when several statements are checked; runs only the checked statements as one batch. {count} is how many are checked.

run_singular.location: Run Statements dialog → Footer: primary button label when exactly one statement is checked; runs just that statement. {count} is 1.

run_without_selection.location: Run Statements dialog → Footer: primary button label shown when no statement is checked; clicking it only reports that a statement must be selected.

select_all.location: Run Statements dialog → Footer: button at the left that checks every statement in the list.

select_none.location: Run Statements dialog → Footer: button beside “Select all” that unchecks every statement in the list; short word meaning “select none”.

selection_required.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown when the Run button in the Run Statements dialog is clicked with no statements checked; the dialog stays open.

title.location: Run Statements dialog → Title bar: dialog title; opened by the “Run Statements…” command, it lists each statement in the editor with a checkbox so you can pick which ones to run.

day.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled exactly one day ago (singular); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

days.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled two or more days ago (plural); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

hour.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled about one hour ago (singular); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

hours.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled two to 23 hours ago (plural); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

just_now.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled less than a minute ago; fills {age} in the timestamp line.

minute.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled about one minute ago (singular); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

minutes.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: age phrase for a schema snapshot pulled two to 59 minutes ago (plural); fills {age} in the timestamp line.

timestamp.location: Workbench → Refresh schema button tooltips: snapshot age text inserted after “last pulled”; {timestamp} is the local date and time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm), {age} the relative age such as “Just now”.

ai_pending.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → AI review pending note: dimmed note under the SQL preview while the required AI review of the pending changes is still running; Save stays disabled until it finishes.

ai_wait.value: 等待 AI 审查 — 该连接在保存暂存更改前需要审查
ai_wait.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown if Save is attempted in Confirm Staged Changes before the AI review this connection requires has finished.

cancel.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Footer: button between “Copy SQL” and “Save” that closes the dialog without saving; the staged changes stay pending in the grid.

cancelled_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: message shown after the Confirm Staged Changes dialog is cancelled or closed; nothing was written to the database.

commit_plural.value: 将 {count} 的暂存更改一次性提交到 {table}
commit_plural.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Commit summary line (plural): summary line of what Save will do when several changes are pending; {count} is the number of changes, {table} the target table name.

commit_singular.value: 将 {count} 的暂存更改一次性提交到 {table}
commit_singular.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Commit summary line (singular): summary line of what Save will do when exactly one change is pending; {count} is 1, {table} the target table name.

conflict_plural.value: 更改 {statement_index} 影响了 {affected} 行；未保存任何内容
conflict_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar: error after saving staged changes is rolled back because one change matched an unexpected number of rows (zero or several); {statement_index} is the change number, {affected} the row count.

conflict_singular.value: 更改 {statement_index} 影响了 {affected} 行；未保存任何内容
conflict_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar: singular form of the rolled-back save error, used when the reported row count is exactly one; {statement_index} is the change number, {affected} is 1. Nothing was saved.

copy_sql.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Footer: first button, copies the SQL script for the pending changes to the clipboard without saving them.

production_read_only.value: 生产连接为只读 — 在保存暂存更改前请解锁写入权限
production_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when saving staged grid changes on a Production connection whose writes are still locked; unlock writes first.

save.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Footer: warning-colored primary button that commits all pending grid changes to the database in one transaction.

saved_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message after the pending grid changes were committed to the database and the grid refreshed.

table_fallback.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Summary line: placeholder put in {table} when the target table name of the staged changes is unknown; keep the parentheses.

title.location: Confirm Staged Changes dialog → Title bar: dialog title, shown before saving pending grid edits when the connection requires confirmation, is read-only, or needs an AI review.

ready.location: Workbench → Status bar: initial idle message shown when SQLLY starts, before any query or action has reported a status.

terminal_launch_ready.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal flow: idle status restored while waiting for the terminal notice or after cancellation.

all_tabs_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query tab strip: tooltip on the chevron button at the right end that opens a searchable list of all open query tabs.

new_query_tooltip.location: Workbench → Query tab strip: tooltip on the plus button after the last tab that opens a new query tab; ⌘N is the keyboard shortcut.

search_placeholder.location: Workbench → Query tab strip → All tabs list: placeholder in the filter box at the top of the list, used to find an open tab by typing part of its name.

preview_empty_query.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → query preview: placeholder shown when the highlighted query editor contains no text.

preview_more_lines_plural.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → query preview: truncation marker when multiple SQL lines are omitted; {count} is the omitted line count.

preview_more_lines_singular.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → query preview: truncation marker when exactly one SQL line is omitted; {count} is 1.

preview_not_run.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: status shown when the highlighted query has never completed a run.

preview_ran_row_plural.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: completed query with zero or multiple result rows and at most one result set; {relative} is the localized elapsed time and {count} is the grouped row count.

preview_ran_row_plural_result_sets.value: 已运行 {relative} · {count} 行 · {result_set_count} 结果集
preview_ran_row_plural_result_sets.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: completed query with zero or multiple rows and multiple result sets; {relative} is localized elapsed time, {count} is the grouped row count, and {result_set_count} is greater than 1.

preview_ran_row_singular.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: completed query with one result row and at most one result set; {relative} is the localized elapsed time and {count} is 1.

preview_ran_row_singular_result_sets.value: 已运行 {relative} · {count} 行 · {result_set_count} 结果集
preview_ran_row_singular_result_sets.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: completed query with one result row and multiple result sets; {relative} is localized elapsed time, {count} is 1, and {result_set_count} is greater than 1.

relative_days_ago.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: relative completion time in whole days; {count} is the elapsed day count.

relative_hours_ago.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: relative completion time in whole hours; {count} is the elapsed hour count.

relative_just_now.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: relative completion time for a query that finished less than five seconds ago.

relative_minutes_ago.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: relative completion time in whole minutes; {count} is the elapsed minute count.

relative_seconds_ago.location: Workbench → Ctrl+Tab switcher → preview metadata: relative completion time in seconds; {count} is a whole number from 5 through 59.

clickhouse_native_forward_failed.value: 无法为 ClickHouse 的原生端口 {native_port} 打开隧道转发：{detail}
clickhouse_native_forward_failed.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when a second SSH tunnel forward to ClickHouse's native-protocol port cannot be opened; {native_port} is the port number, {detail} the SSH library's own error text.

clickhouse_native_forward_missing.value: clickhouse-client 使用 ClickHouse 的本地协议，但无法打开到本地端口的隧道转发——请改为打开查询标签，或在无隧道的情况下连接。
clickhouse_native_forward_missing.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning for a tunneled ClickHouse connection when no tunnel forward to the native-protocol port exists for clickhouse-client.

duckdb_file_in_use.value: SQLLY 已打开此 DuckDB 文件，而 DuckDB 每次只允许一个进程使用文件——请断开此连接并关闭其查询标签，然后打开终端。
duckdb_file_in_use.location: Explorer → DuckDB node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when SQLLY itself holds the DuckDB file open, so the duckdb client cannot take its lock.

dump_tool_not_interactive.value: {tool} 是一个导出工具，而不是交互式 CLI。
dump_tool_not_interactive.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when a backup tool was picked instead of an interactive client; {tool} is the tool name such as pg_dump. Internal safeguard, rarely seen.

in_memory_no_file.value: 此连接是内存中的——没有文件可打开。
in_memory_no_file.location: Explorer → DuckDB or SQLite node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the connection is in-memory and the command-line client has no database file to open.

install_clickhouse_client.value: 安装 clickhouse-client 以打开终端。
install_clickhouse_client.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when clickhouse-client is not installed on this computer.

install_duckdb.value: 安装 duckdb 以打开终端。
install_duckdb.location: Explorer → DuckDB node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the duckdb command-line client is not installed on this computer.

install_mysql.value: 安装 MySQL 或 MariaDB 客户端（mysql）以打开终端。
install_mysql.location: Explorer → MySQL or MariaDB node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the mysql command-line client is not installed on this computer.

install_oracle.value: 安装 Oracle SQL*Plus 或 SQLcl 以打开终端。
install_oracle.location: Explorer → Oracle node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when neither Oracle SQL*Plus nor SQLcl is installed on this computer.

install_psql.value: 安装 PostgreSQL 客户端（psql）以打开终端
install_psql.location: Explorer → PostgreSQL node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the psql command-line client is not installed on this computer.

install_redis_cli.value: 安装 redis-cli（随 Redis 一起提供）以打开终端
install_redis_cli.location: Explorer → Redis node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the redis-cli command-line client is not installed on this computer.

install_sqlcmd.value: 安装 sqlcmd（微软的 SQL Server 命令行工具）以打开终端
install_sqlcmd.location: Explorer → SQL Server node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when Microsoft's sqlcmd command-line tool is not installed on this computer.

install_sqlite3.value: 安装 sqlite3 以打开终端
install_sqlite3.location: Explorer → SQLite node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the sqlite3 command-line client is not installed on this computer.

invalid_program_path.location: Windows → Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the discovered command-line client path contains a quote character; {path} is that path.

launcher_create_failed.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the temporary launcher script for the terminal cannot be created; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

launcher_write_failed.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the temporary launcher script for the terminal cannot be written; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

no_terminal_emulator.value: 无法启动任何终端模拟器（{detail}）
no_terminal_emulator.location: Linux → Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when none of the known terminal emulators could be started; {detail} lists each program tried with the operating system's error.

note_clickhouse_custom_certificates.value: clickhouse-client 使用其自身配置文件（~/.clickhouse-client/config.xml 中的 openSSL.client）中的自定义 CA 或客户端证书，而不是来自 SQLLY。
note_clickhouse_custom_certificates.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the connection uses a custom CA or client certificate that clickhouse-client cannot take from SQLLY.

note_clickhouse_native_forward.value: clickhouse-client 通过此连接隧道的第二次转发（127.0.0.1:{forward_port}）到达服务器的本机端口 {native_port}；SQLLY 会保持其打开状态，直到你断开此连接或退出——断开连接会关闭它并结束终端会话。
note_clickhouse_native_forward.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message for an SSH-tunneled connection; {native_port} is the server's native port, {forward_port} the local forward port.

note_clickhouse_native_port_assumed.value: clickhouse-client 使用 ClickHouse 的本机协议，因此它连接到端口 {native_port}（假定——此连接的端口 {http_port} 是 HTTP；如果服务器使用其他端口，请在连接上设置本机端口）。
note_clickhouse_native_port_assumed.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the native-protocol port was guessed from the HTTP port; {native_port} is the guessed port, {http_port} the connection's HTTP port.

note_clickhouse_native_port_configured.value: clickhouse-client 在端口 {native_port}（此连接的本机端口）上使用 ClickHouse 的本机协议；SQLLY 在 {http_port} 上使用 HTTP。
note_clickhouse_native_port_configured.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the connection's Native port setting differs from its HTTP port; {native_port} is the native port, {http_port} the HTTP port.

note_clickhouse_native_port_default.value: clickhouse-client 在端口 {native_port} 上使用 ClickHouse 的本机协议；SQLLY 在 {http_port} 上使用 HTTP。
note_clickhouse_native_port_default.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the conventional native port is used alongside the HTTP port; {native_port} is the native port, {http_port} the HTTP port.

note_clickhouse_tunnel_certificate.value: 通过 SSH 隧道，clickhouse-client 会针对 127.0.0.1 检查服务器证书；如果它拒绝证书，请在此连接上信任服务器证书或在没有隧道的情况下连接。
note_clickhouse_tunnel_certificate.location: Explorer → ClickHouse node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when an SSH-tunneled connection verifies the server certificate.

note_cloud_iam_password_prompt.value: {tool} 会要求输入密码：云 IAM 令牌会在 SQLLY 连接时生成，并且不会传递给终端。
note_cloud_iam_password_prompt.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message for AWS/GCP IAM connections; {tool} is the command-line client name such as psql.

note_mariadb_tunnel_unverified.value: 通过 SSH 隧道，mariadb 客户端无法检查服务器的主机名，因此终端会话被加密，但证书未经过验证。
note_mariadb_tunnel_unverified.location: Explorer → MariaDB node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the connection uses an SSH tunnel and full certificate verification.

note_mysql_missing_ca.value: mysql 客户端需要一个 CA 文件来验证服务器证书，但没有找到；终端会话已加密但未验证。请在连接的 TLS 设置中添加 CA 文件以进行验证。
note_mysql_missing_ca.location: Explorer → MySQL node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when certificate verification is on but no CA file could be found for the mysql client.

note_mysql_tunnel_chain_only.value: 通过 SSH 隧道，mysql 客户端无法检查服务器的主机名，因此它只验证证书链。
note_mysql_tunnel_chain_only.location: Explorer → MySQL node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when the connection uses an SSH tunnel and full certificate verification.

note_sqlcmd_tunnel_certificate.value: 通过 SSH 隧道，sqlcmd 会将服务器证书与 127.0.0.1 进行检查（此 sqlcmd 没有 -F host-name-in-certificate 选项；go-sqlcmd 1.9+ 和 ODBC sqlcmd 18+ 支持此选项）；如果它拒绝证书，请在不使用隧道的情况下连接或在此连接上信任服务器证书。
note_sqlcmd_tunnel_certificate.location: Explorer → SQL Server node → Open in Terminal: caveat appended to the status-bar success message when an SSH-tunneled connection verifies certificates but the installed sqlcmd cannot name the real host.

opened.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal → success status without caveats: message after the terminal starts; {name} is the connection name.

opened_with_notes.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal → completion status with caveats: message after the terminal starts; {name} is the connection name and {notes} contains the launch caveats.

opening.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal → launch status: busy message after confirmation when the terminal is being spawned; {name} is the connection name.

oracle_username_missing.value: Oracle 连接需要 SQL*Plus 的用户名 — 此配置文件中未存储
oracle_username_missing.location: Explorer → Oracle node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the Oracle connection has no stored user name to hand to SQL*Plus.

preparing.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal → preparation status: busy message while credentials, the CLI, and any tunnel are prepared; {name} is the connection name.

sandbox_blocked.value: 在 Mac App Store 版本的 SQLLY 中，“在终端中打开”不可用，因为 App Store 沙盒不允许启动安装在 Mac 上的程序。请参阅“帮助 ▸ Mac App Store 版本”了解区别。
sandbox_blocked.location: Mac App Store edition → Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the App Store sandbox blocks launching a terminal program.

terminal_start_failed.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the terminal application (Terminal.app or the Windows console) cannot be started; {detail} is the operating system's own error text.

tool_not_found.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the command-line client disappeared between the menu check and the launch; {tool} is the program name such as psql.

tunnel_failed.value: 无法为终端打开 SSH 隧道：{detail}
tunnel_failed.location: Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when the connection's SSH tunnel cannot be opened for the terminal; {detail} is the SSH library's own error text and stays untranslated.

unsupported_duckdb_in_memory.value: 此 DuckDB 连接是内存中的 — 没有文件可打开
unsupported_duckdb_in_memory.location: Explorer → DuckDB node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the DuckDB connection is in-memory and has no database file for the duckdb client to open.

unsupported_engine.value: 此引擎不支持“在终端中打开”
unsupported_engine.location: Explorer → Server node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the connection's database engine has no command-line client SQLLY can open.

unsupported_entra_sign_in.value: sqlcmd 无法使用此连接的 Entra 登录 — 请使用 SQL 或集成认证
unsupported_entra_sign_in.location: Explorer → SQL Server node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the connection signs in with Microsoft Entra, which sqlcmd cannot take over.

unsupported_libsql_http.value: libSQL / Turso 使用 HTTP — 请使用 Turso CLI (turso db shell) 来访问终端
unsupported_libsql_http.location: Explorer → libSQL / Turso node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) explaining libSQL speaks HTTP and pointing to the Turso CLI instead.

unsupported_relay_route.value: 在终端中打开需要直接连接——这个连接是通过中继桥进行的
unsupported_relay_route.location: Explorer → Server node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the connection is reached through a relay bridge, so a local command-line client cannot dial it.

unsupported_sqlite_in_memory.value: 此 SQLite 连接是内存中的——没有文件可供打开
unsupported_sqlite_in_memory.location: Explorer → SQLite node right-click menu → Open in Terminal: disabled menu item (and status-bar warning) when the SQLite connection is in-memory and has no database file for sqlite3 to open.

windows_line_break.value: 连接设置包含换行符，Windows 命令行无法处理
windows_line_break.location: Windows → Explorer → Server node → Open in Terminal: status-bar warning when a connection setting (host, user, database, file path) contains a line break the Windows command line cannot carry.

cancel_button.location: Open in Terminal notice dialog → Footer: secondary button that closes the notice without writing the launcher script or opening Terminal.

cleanup_script.value: 它的第一行会在 {tool} 开始前删除它。如果终端从未运行它，SQLLY 会在 {minutes} 分钟内删除
cleanup_script.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → second bullet: launcher self-deletion before {tool} starts and fallback cleanup within {minutes} minutes.

dont_show_again.location: Open in Terminal notice dialog → Footer: checkbox label at the left; when checked, this password-on-disk notice is not shown again for later terminal launches.

launcher_explanation.value: Terminal.app 无法直接从 SQLLY 接收密码，因此 SQLLY 将密码写入一个短的启动脚本，由终端运行
launcher_explanation.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → explanation: reason SQLLY uses a short launcher script to supply the password to Terminal.app.

no_command_line_password.value: 密码永远不会出现在命令行上，因此其他进程无法通过 ps 读取
no_command_line_password.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → third bullet: assurance that the password is not exposed in command-line arguments visible through ps.

open_button.location: Open in Terminal notice dialog → Footer: primary button that writes the temporary launcher script and opens Terminal running the database command-line tool.

password_on_disk.value: 在 macOS 上，{name} 的密码会短暂地写入磁盘。
password_on_disk.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → headline: explanation that the saved password for connection {name} is briefly written to disk on macOS.

private_script.value: 只有你的 macOS 用户可以读取该脚本，它位于一个私有的临时文件夹中。
private_script.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → first bullet: filesystem permissions and private temporary location of the launcher script.

re_enable_hint.value: 如果你隐藏此提示，可以在 设置 › 高级 › 数据库工具 中重新启用它。
re_enable_hint.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal notice → footnote: explanation of where to re-enable the notice after choosing not to show it again.

remove_saved_password.value: 要完全不在磁盘上存储它，请从此连接中删除已保存的密码，{tool} 将在终端中请求输入。
remove_saved_password.location: Workbench → Open in Terminal password notice → fourth bullet: alternative of removing the saved connection password so {tool} prompts interactively instead.

title.location: Open in Terminal notice dialog → Title bar: title of the notice shown before Object Explorer’s Open in Terminal writes a connection password into a temporary launcher script on macOS.

ai_working.location: Workbench → Window title bar → Layout toggles: small dimmed indicator with a dot shown while an AI request is in progress, left of the output-panel toggle.

toggle_ai_tooltip.location: Workbench → Window title bar → Layout toggles: tooltip on the right-sidebar icon button that shows or hides the AI drawer.

toggle_output_tooltip.location: Workbench → Window title bar → Layout toggles: tooltip on the bottom-panel icon button that shows or hides the results/output panel; ⌘J is the shortcut.

toggle_sidebar_tooltip.location: Workbench → Window title bar → Layout toggles: tooltip on the left-sidebar icon button that shows or hides the sidebar with the Object Explorer.

activity_monitor_feature.location: Activity Monitor → Live tabs on a relay connection: noun phrase naming the Activity Monitor’s live capture, inserted as {feature} into the status-bar warning that the feature needs a direct connection rather than a relay bridge.

connect_admin_tool.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when an admin tool is opened with no active connection, asking the user to connect first; {tool} is the tool’s name, such as Activity Monitor or Schema History.

data_transfer_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks popover: failure state text on the Data Transfer task row, shown when the transfer between connections ends with an error.

data_transfer_task_label.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks popover: row label naming a running Data Transfer job (copying tables between connections) while it shows progress.

data_transfer_title.location: Tools → Data Transfer → Results window: title of the text output window that opens with the transfer summary after a data transfer finishes or fails.

database_search_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error when Search Database for Value is chosen in the browser build.

direct_route_required.value: {feature}需要直连；该连接是通过中继桥实现的。
direct_route_required.location: Workbench → direct-database tool on a relay-routed connection: refusal explaining that {feature} requires a direct connection rather than the active relay bridge.

dump_connect.value: 连接到数据库以导出转储
dump_connect.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when Export Database as SQL (database dump) is started with no active connection; it should ask the user to connect to a server before dumping a database.

dump_export_unavailable.value: 导出数据库转储不可用
dump_export_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error when Export Database as SQL is chosen in the browser build.

dump_task_label.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks popover: row label for a running database dump; {name} is the output file name the dump is being written to.

help_title.location: Help menu → SQLLY Help: title of the help window that lists every command and its keyboard shortcut.

import_clipboard_empty.value: 剪贴板没有要导入的文本
import_clipboard_empty.location: Tools → Import from Clipboard → Status bar: info message shown when Import from Clipboard is chosen but the clipboard holds no text, so nothing is imported.

import_clipboard_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error when Import from Clipboard is chosen in the browser build.

manage_databases_connect.value: 连接到服务器以管理数据库
manage_databases_connect.location: Explorer → Server context menu → New Database / Drop Database: status-bar message shown when the create or drop database dialog is requested but no server connection can be resolved.

native_backup_feature.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Native backup task on a relay connection: noun phrase naming a native backup (pg_dump or mysqldump), inserted as {feature} into the refusal saying it needs a direct connection.

native_restore_tool_missing.value: 未找到 {tool} — 在 工具 ▸ 选项 ▸ 高级 ▸ 数据库工具 中设置路径
native_restore_tool_missing.location: Tools → Backup / Restore on PostgreSQL or MySQL → Status bar: message shown when the restore program cannot be found; {tool} is the program name (pg_restore or mysql); keep the settings path wording consistent with the Options menu.

no_active_connection_run_file.location: Tools → Run SQL File → Status bar: error shown when Run SQL File is chosen with no active connection; it should tell the user to connect before running a script file.

no_active_connection_search.location: Tools → Search Database for Value → Status bar: error shown when the value search is started with no active connection; it should tell the user to connect before searching.

output_ready.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a tool’s text output window opens; {title} is that window’s title (for example Run SQL File or SQLLY Help).

redis_all_databases.location: Explorer → Redis server → Show Only Databases → Status bar: success message shown after the list is cleared, meaning the explorer again lists every logical Redis database for the connection.

redis_connect_action.value: 首先连接到 Redis 服务器
redis_connect_action.location: Explorer → Redis key context menu (rename, copy, export, set TTL, etc.) → Status bar: info message shown when the action cannot find the key’s connection; it should ask the user to connect to the Redis server first.

redis_connect_dialog.value: 首先连接到 Redis 服务器
redis_connect_dialog.location: Explorer → Redis database node → Key browser prompts (key filter, new key, etc.) → Status bar: info message shown when the prompt cannot resolve the node’s connection; asks the user to connect first.

redis_selected_keys_no_connection.value: 先打开键列表的选项卡并将其连接到对应的 Redis 服务器
redis_selected_keys_no_connection.location: Results grid → Redis Keys menu → Status bar: info shown when the selected keys cannot be acted on because the grid is not in the active tab or the tab is not connected to Redis.

redis_selected_keys_none.value: 先选择一行或多行的键
redis_selected_keys_none.location: Results grid → Redis Keys menu → Status bar: info shown when the selection holds no key names.

redis_value_search_opened.value: 在新选项卡上打开了针对值的 FT.SEARCH — 检查查询，然后运行它
redis_value_search_opened.location: Explorer → Filter Keys → Search values with FT.SEARCH… → Status bar: info shown after the search script opens in a new query tab.

redis_database_name_removed.value: 已移除 db{database} 的名称
redis_database_name_removed.location: Explorer → Redis database → Name Database → Status bar: success message shown after the local display name is cleared; {database} is the logical database number (as in db3).

redis_database_named.location: Explorer → Redis database → Name Database → Status bar: success message shown after a local display name is saved; {database} is the logical database number, {alias} the new name.

redis_filter_applied.location: Explorer → Redis database → Filter Keys dialog → Status bar: info message shown after the key-name match pattern is applied and the key list reloads with only matching keys.

redis_profiler_feature.location: Activity Monitor → Redis Profiler tab on a relay connection: noun phrase naming the Redis profiler (MONITOR capture), inserted as {feature} into the warning that it needs a direct connection.

redis_pubsub_feature.location: Activity Monitor → Redis Pub/Sub tab on a relay connection: noun phrase naming the Redis Pub/Sub viewer, inserted as {feature} into the warning that it needs a direct connection.

redis_save_before_database_settings.value: 在更改数据库列表方式之前保存连接
redis_save_before_database_settings.location: Explorer → Redis database → Name Database / Show Only Databases → Status bar: error shown when the connection is not a saved connection, so it must be saved before these per-database settings can be stored.

redis_visible_databases.location: Explorer → Redis server → Show Only Databases → Status bar: success message shown after the list is saved; {databases} is the comma-separated list of logical database numbers the explorer will show.

run_file_production_locked.value: 生产环境为只读。从状态栏芯片解锁写入以运行 SQL 文件。
run_file_production_locked.location: Tools → Run SQL File → Status bar: error shown when the active connection is a production connection whose writes are locked, so a script file cannot be run until writes are unlocked.

run_sql_file_title.location: Tools → Run SQL File → Results window: title of the text output window that opens with the execution log after a script file finishes or fails.

run_sql_file_unavailable.value: 不支持从磁盘运行 SQL 文件
run_sql_file_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error when Run SQL File is chosen in the browser build.

save_snapshot_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Save Schema Snapshot action: message shown because local schema snapshots are unavailable.

schedule_already_running.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Run now → Status bar: info message shown when the user clicks Run now on a scheduled task that is already running.

schedule_another_running.value: 另一个计划任务正在运行——请在其完成后重试
schedule_another_running.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Run now → Status bar: info message shown when Run now is clicked while a different scheduled task is still running; only one runs at a time.

schedule_cancelled.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a scheduled task run is cancelled; {kind} is the task kind (dump, backup, or export) and {database} the database it ran against.

schedule_connection_missing.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: reason recorded when a scheduled task is disabled because its saved connection no longer exists.

schedule_dump_connect.value: 连接到数据库以安排导出
schedule_dump_connect.location: Tools → Schedule Task (Dump, Backup, or Query Export) → Status bar: info message shown when a new schedule is started with no active connection; asks the user to connect first.

schedule_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a scheduled task cannot start; {database} is the target database, {error} the reason (missing tool, unsupported engine, unwritable folder, etc.).

schedule_finished.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown when a scheduled task run completes; {kind} is the task kind (dump, backup, or export) and {database} the database it ran against.

schedule_kind_backup.location: Workbench → Status bar → Scheduled task messages: short noun naming a native backup task (pg_dump or mysqldump), inserted as {kind} into the finished, cancelled, and failed messages.

schedule_kind_dump.location: Workbench → Status bar → Scheduled task messages: short noun naming a built-in SQL dump task, inserted as {kind} into the finished, cancelled, and failed messages.

schedule_kind_export.location: Workbench → Status bar → Scheduled task messages: short noun naming a saved-query export task, inserted as {kind} into the finished, cancelled, and failed messages.

schedule_kind_failed.location: Workbench → Status bar: error shown when a scheduled task fails while running; {kind} is the task kind (dump, backup, or export), {database} the target database, {error} the failure reason.

schedule_native_backup_unsupported.value: {engine} 没有本机备份工具 — 将计划切换为内置转储
schedule_native_backup_unsupported.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Native backup task: failure reason shown when the connection’s engine has no native backup tool; {engine} is the database engine name, such as SQLite.

schedule_native_tool_missing.value: 未找到 {tool} — 安装它或在 工具 ▸ 选项 ▸ 高级 ▸ 数据库工具 中设置其路径
schedule_native_tool_missing.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Native backup task: failure reason shown when the backup program cannot be found on this machine; {tool} is the program’s file name, such as pg_dump or mysqldump.

schedule_not_read_only_fallback.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Query export task: fallback reason phrase inserted as {reason} into the not-read-only refusal when no specific reason is known; a predicate that follows the query name.

schedule_output_folder_failed.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Scheduled task run: failure reason shown when the output folder cannot be created; {path} is the folder path, {error} the operating-system error.

schedule_production_skipped.value: 已跳过 — 生产连接不会自动运行
schedule_production_skipped.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: reason recorded when a scheduled run is skipped because its connection is marked as production.

schedule_production_skipped_database.value: 已跳过 — 生产连接不会自动运行 ({database})
schedule_production_skipped_database.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a scheduled task is skipped because its connection is a production connection; {database} is the scheduled task’s database.

schedule_query_missing.value: 保存的查询 '{query}' 在 SQL 库中已不存在
schedule_query_missing.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: reason recorded when a query export task is disabled because its saved query file is gone from the SQL Library; {query} is the query’s name.

schedule_query_not_read_only.value: 计划查询导出仅运行只读 SELECT 查询 — '{query}' {reason}
schedule_query_not_read_only.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Query export task: failure reason shown when the saved query is not a read-only SELECT and so will not run unattended; {query} is the query name, {reason} why it was refused.

schedule_result_cancelled.value: 已取消 — 部分输出位于 {path}
schedule_result_cancelled.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: result recorded when a scheduled run was cancelled before it finished; {path} is the partial output file.

schedule_result_error.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: result recorded when a scheduled run could not start; {error} is the reason.

schedule_result_success.location: Settings → Scheduled Dumps → Last result column: result recorded after a successful scheduled run; {count} is the number of rows written and {path} the output file.

schedule_runtime_result_error.location: Workbench → scheduled job history: failure recorded when the running scheduled job returns an error; {error} is the runtime error.

schedule_saved.value: 已保存 {database} 的计划任务
schedule_saved.location: Tools → Schedule Task dialog → Status bar: success message shown after a new or edited scheduled task is saved; {database} is the database the task runs against.

scheduled_dumps_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” error when Schedule Task (dump, backup, or query export) is chosen in the browser build.

schema_compare_connect.value: 连接到数据库以打开模式比较
schema_compare_connect.location: Tools → Schema History → Compare → Status bar: info message shown when comparing a saved snapshot whose connection no longer exists and no connection is active; asks the user to connect.

schema_compare_deploy_title.location: Tools → Schema Compare → Deploy → Results window: title of the text output window that opens with the deployment log after deploying schema differences.

schema_deploy_production_locked.value: 生产环境为只读。从状态栏芯片解锁写入以部署模式更改。
schema_deploy_production_locked.location: Tools → Schema Compare → Deploy → Status bar: error shown when the deploy target is a production connection whose writes are locked; writes must be unlocked before deploying.

schema_history_select_database.value: 选择一个数据库以打开其模式历史
schema_history_select_database.location: Tools → Schema History → Status bar: info message shown when Schema History is opened while the connection has no database selected; asks the user to pick a database first.

scripted_comparison_target.value: 已生成到新选项卡的比较目标 — 运行前请审核
scripted_comparison_target.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a tool scripts SQL into a new editor tab that it also switches to that tool’s target connection (for example a comparison’s target side).

scripted_new_tab.value: 已生成到新选项卡 — 运行前请审核
scripted_new_tab.location: Workbench → Status bar: info message shown when a tool dialog’s Script action opens the generated SQL in a new editor tab on the current connection.

snapshot_saved.value: 已保存架构快照 {title} ({count} 个对象)
snapshot_saved.location: Tools → Save Schema Snapshot → Status bar: success message shown after the snapshot is saved; {title} is the snapshot’s name and {count} the number of schema objects captured.

snapshot_select_database.value: 选择一个数据库以快照其架构
snapshot_select_database.location: Tools → Save Schema Snapshot → Status bar: info message shown when a snapshot is requested while the connection has no database selected; asks the user to pick a database first.

snapshots_unavailable.location: Browser-hosted SQLLY → Status bar: feature name inserted into the “not available in the browser” message when Schema History or Save Schema Snapshot is used in the browser build.

structure_connect.value: 连接到数据库以编辑表结构
structure_connect.location: Explorer → Table → Edit Structure → Status bar: info message shown when the structure editor cannot resolve the table’s connection; asks the user to connect first.

structure_credentials_failed.location: Explorer → Table → Edit Structure → Status bar: message shown when the connection’s saved credentials cannot be loaded to read the table definition; {error} is the reason.

structure_loading.location: Explorer → Table → Edit Structure → Status bar: progress message shown while the table definition is being read before the structure editor opens; {table} is the table name.

structure_palette_select_table.value: 请先在资源管理器中选择一个表
structure_palette_select_table.location: Command Palette → Edit Structure → Status bar: info message shown when the command runs without a table selected in the Explorer; asks the user to select a table first.

structure_ready.value: 结构编辑器已就绪 — 在生成脚本前请审核更改
structure_ready.location: Explorer → Table → Edit Structure → Status bar: success message shown once the table definition has loaded and the structure editor dialog opens.

structure_select_table.value: 请先在资源管理器中选择一个表
structure_select_table.location: Explorer → Context menu → Edit Structure → Status bar: info message shown when the selected tree node has no table name; asks the user to select a table.

table_export_cancelled.location: Explorer → Export Tables → Status bar: info message shown when the multi-table export is cancelled before it finishes.

table_export_connect.value: 连接到数据库以导出表
table_export_connect.location: Explorer → Export Tables → Status bar: info message shown when the multi-table export dialog is opened with no active connection; asks the user to connect first.

table_export_failures.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks popover: failure state on the table-export task row; {count} is the number of tables that failed to export.

table_export_partial.value: 已导出 {succeeded} 张 {total} 表到 {path} — {failed} 失败
table_export_partial.location: Explorer → Export Tables → Status bar: message shown when only some tables exported; {succeeded} of {total} tables were written to the folder {path}, and {failed} tables failed.

table_export_succeeded.location: Explorer → Export Tables → Status bar: success message shown when every table exported; {count} is the number of tables written and {path} the destination folder.

table_export_task_label.location: Workbench → Status bar → Background tasks popover: row label for a running multi-table export; {count} is the number of tables and {path} the destination folder.

tenant_scoping_connect.value: 连接到数据库以配置租户范围
tenant_scoping_connect.location: Tools → Tenant Scoping → Status bar: info message shown when Tenant Scoping is opened with no active connection; asks the user to connect to a database first.

commit_button.location: Uncommitted transaction dialog → Footer buttons (commit): primary button that commits the tab’s pending manual-mode statements and then closes the tab.

rollback_button.location: Uncommitted transaction dialog → Footer buttons (rollback): secondary button that rolls back the tab’s pending manual-mode statements and then closes the tab.

title.location: Uncommitted transaction dialog → Title bar: title of the confirmation shown when closing an editor tab that still has an open manual-commit transaction.

uncommitted_prompt.value: 选项卡 "{tab_name}" 有 {count} 个未提交的语句。
uncommitted_prompt.location: Uncommitted transaction dialog → Message body: body text asking what to do with the open transaction; {tab_name} is the editor tab’s name and {count} the number of uncommitted statements.

auto_enabled.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge → Status bar: info message shown after switching the tab back to auto-commit mode (any open transaction is rolled back).

begin_failed.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: error shown when SQLLY could not start the manual transaction on the server before running the statement.

cancel_lost_transaction.value: 事务丢失 — 连接中断；服务器已回滚
cancel_lost_transaction.location: Workbench → cancelled manual-transaction query: error shown when cancellation leaves the server transaction in the Lost state.

committed.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: success message shown after Transaction: Commit; {count} is the number of statements committed.

connect_manual.value: 连接到数据库以使用手动提交模式
connect_manual.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge: tooltip and status-bar reason shown when manual commit mode is unavailable because the tab has no database connection.

end_failed.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: error shown when the commit or rollback request to the server could not be completed.

forced_rollback.value: 此连接的环境强制每次运行回滚
forced_rollback.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge: tooltip and status-bar reason shown when manual commit mode is unavailable because the connection’s environment rolls back every run.

idle_rollback_notification.value: 在标签“{tab}”中闲置事务在 {minutes} 分钟后已回滚
idle_rollback_notification.location: Workbench → Toast notification: warning shown when an idle manual transaction is rolled back automatically; {tab} is the editor tab’s name and {minutes} how long it was idle.

lost.value: 事务丢失 — 连接中断；服务器已回滚
lost.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: error shown when the connection dropped during an open manual transaction, so the server has rolled the transaction back.

manual_enabled.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge → Status bar: info message shown after switching the tab to manual commit mode, where statements stay uncommitted until Commit.

manual_relay_unavailable.value: 手动提交模式在中继上不可用
manual_relay_unavailable.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge: tooltip and status-bar reason shown when manual commit mode is unavailable because the connection goes through a relay bridge.

no_active_connection.location: Workbench → Status bar → Read-only chip → Unlock: info message shown when the user tries to unlock writes but no connection is active.

not_read_only.location: Workbench → Status bar → Read-only chip → Unlock: info message shown when unlocking writes is requested but the active connection is not a read-only connection.

production_commit_locked.value: 生产环境为只读 — 在提交前解锁写入
production_commit_locked.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Transaction: Commit → Status bar: error shown when committing on a production connection whose writes are locked; writes must be unlocked first.

read_only_locked.location: Workbench → Status bar → Read-only chip: info message shown when writes on a read-only connection are locked again, either manually or when the unlock window ends.

read_only_unlock_expired.location: Workbench → read-only unlock timer: status shown when the final temporary write unlock expires.

read_only_unlocked.value: 只读连接已为 {duration} 解锁
read_only_unlocked.location: Workbench → Status bar → Read-only chip → Unlock: info message shown after writes are temporarily allowed; {duration} is the unlock window, such as “5 min”.

rolled_back.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: short success message shown after Transaction: Rollback discards the tab’s uncommitted statements.

select_only.location: Editor toolbar → Transaction mode badge: tooltip and status-bar reason shown when manual commit mode is unavailable because the connection only allows SELECT statements.

switch_to_auto_enabled.location: Workbench → dirty manual transaction dialog → Switch to Auto Commit: status shown after rollback and the confirmed mode change.

wait_for_statement.location: Editor → Manual commit mode → Status bar: error shown when Commit or Rollback is requested while a statement is still running in the tab; the user must wait for it to finish.

command_problem_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL on a Redis connection: message shown after checking the editor's Redis command lines when two or more problems (unterminated quotes, bad JSON, blocking commands) were found; {count} is the number of problems.

command_problem_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL on a Redis connection: message shown after checking the editor's Redis command lines when exactly one problem was found and underlined; {count} is 1 (singular form).

commands_valid.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL on a Redis connection: message shown when every Redis command line in the editor passed the check; {reason} is the engine's explanation of why SQL parsing does not apply to Redis.

connect_completion_values.value: 连接到数据库以查找列值
connect_completion_values.location: Workbench → value-lookup completion popup: status shown when values cannot be fetched without an active connection.

connect_first.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL: message shown when the user runs Validate SQL on a query tab while no database connection is active, telling them to connect before validating.

connect_lookup_values.value: 连接到数据库以查找列值
connect_lookup_values.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: message shown when the action is run without an active connection, so the column's values cannot be queried.

cursor_column_required.value: 将光标放在列名上以查找值
cursor_column_required.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: message shown when the cursor is not on a word, asking the user to place it on a column name before looking up its values.

debug_hidden.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown after View → Toggle IntelliSense Debug (menu or shortcut) hides the IntelliSense Debug panel.

debug_refreshing.value: IntelliSense 调试 — 正在刷新…
debug_refreshing.location: Workbench → Status bar: progress message shown right after View → Toggle IntelliSense Debug opens the IntelliSense Debug panel, while its diagnostics snapshot is being rebuilt.

debug_shown.location: Workbench → Status bar: confirmation shown when the IntelliSense Debug panel reports it became visible through its own controls (not through the View menu toggle).

debug_visibility_hidden.location: Workbench → IntelliSense debug panel → visibility event: status shown when the panel reports that it was hidden.

error.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL: error message shown when the server-side validation of the editor's SQL fails to run; {error} is the underlying error text from the engine or connection.

fk_status_label.location: Workbench → Status bar → Value completion lookup: label inserted into the lookup progress and result messages for a foreign-key column; {column} is the id column, {table}.{display_column} the referenced table and readable column whose names are listed.

inserted_distinct_plural.value: 为 {column} 插入了 {count} 个不同的值
inserted_distinct_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: success message after the column's distinct values were inserted at the cursor as a comma-separated list; {count} (not 1) is the number of values, {column} the column name.

inserted_distinct_singular.value: 为 {column} 插入了 {count} 个不同的值
inserted_distinct_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: success message when exactly one distinct value was inserted at the cursor; {count} is 1, {column} the column name.

log_validating.location: Log console → validation category: verbose log line written when SQL validation starts for the active tab; {count} is the length of the SQL text in characters.

lookup_distinct_progress.value: 正在查找 {column} 的不同值…
lookup_distinct_progress.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: busy message shown while the distinct values of the column under the cursor are queried from the server; {column} is the column name.

lookup_error.location: Query editor → “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: error text that is inserted into the editor in place of the values list when the distinct-values query fails; {error} is the database or connection error.

lookup_progress.location: Workbench → Status bar → Value completion lookup: busy message shown while the editor's value-completion popup fetches column values from the server; {label} is the column name, or the foreign-key description with its referenced table.

no_values_found.location: Workbench → Status bar → Value completion lookup: message shown when the value-completion fetch returned no rows for the column, so the popup has nothing to offer; {column} is the column name.

nothing_to_validate.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL: message shown when Validate SQL is run on a query tab whose editor is empty or only whitespace.

sending_feedback.value: 正在发送 IntelliSense 反馈…
sending_feedback.location: Workbench → Status bar: busy message shown after the Improve IntelliSense feedback dialog is submitted, while the report is saved and uploaded to SQLLY in the background.

summary.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL: message shown after validation finishes and problems are underlined in the editor; {summary} is a short tally of the errors and warnings found.

table_column_unresolved.value: 无法解析用于值查找的表/列
table_column_unresolved.location: Workbench → Status bar → Value completion lookup: error shown when the editor asks for column value suggestions but SQLLY cannot work out which table and column the cursor refers to.

table_reference_unresolved.value: 无法解析用于值查找的表引用
table_reference_unresolved.location: Workbench → Status bar → Editor “Insert distinct values as IN list” action: error shown when no table reference (such as a FROM clause) can be found in the SQL to look the column's values up in.

validating.location: Workbench → Status bar → Validate SQL: busy message shown while the editor's SQL is sent to the connected database for validation and the result is pending.

values_found.location: Workbench → Status bar → Value completion lookup: success message after the editor's value-completion popup was filled from the server; {count} is the number of values fetched, {label} the column (or foreign-key) description.

read_failed.location: Main window → Status bar → Saved local data files: error when a saved settings file (saved charts, filters, column layouts, import profiles, deploy carts, scheduled dumps) exists but cannot be read from disk; {path} is the file path and {detail} the operating-system error. Often shown at the start of a longer error, so it has no trailing period.

invalid_json.location: Main window → Status bar → Saved local data files: error when a saved settings file (saved charts, filters, column layouts, import profiles, deploy carts, scheduled dumps) exists but its JSON cannot be parsed, so SQLLY leaves the file unchanged; {path} is the file path and {detail} the parser error. Often shown at the start of a longer error, so it has no trailing period.

connections_unreadable.value: 无法加载已保存的连接，因此在修复文件之前，连接更改将无法保存：{error}
connections_unreadable.location: Main window → Startup warning toast: shown once at launch when the saved connections file exists but could not be read or parsed; the app shows no saved connections and does not save connection changes, so the file is left untouched for the user to fix or restore; {error} is the technical reason. Full sentence.

session_preserved.value: 无法恢复您上次的会话。文件已保存在 {path}，因此未保存的查询文本不会丢失。
session_preserved.location: Main window → Startup warning toast: shown once at launch when the saved workspace session (open tabs and unsaved query text) could not be read; the unreadable file was moved aside instead of being overwritten, and {path} is where it now is, so unsaved scripts can be recovered by hand. Full sentence.

add_server.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Empty state: clickable accent link under the server icon, shown when no connections are saved yet, that opens the dialog to add a new server connection.

browser_demo.value: 标签页内演示 — 仅示例数据库。
browser_demo.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Empty state (browser edition only): dim caption under the server icon shown in the web demo when no connections exist; adding servers is not available there.

add_server_button.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Object Explorer toolbar: plus-icon button that opens the new-server connection dialog.

close_filter_tooltip.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Filter bar: tooltip on the X icon beside the object filter field; clicking it closes the filter field and returns the action bar.

filter_button.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Object Explorer toolbar: search-icon button that opens the object filter field.

filter_placeholder.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Filter bar: placeholder in the field that filters the object tree by name; text wrapped in slashes such as /pattern/ is matched as a regular expression.

invalid_regex_hint.value: 正则表达式：用 / 关闭模式（添加 c 区分大小写）
invalid_regex_hint.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Filter bar: dim hint under the filter field shown when the text starts with / but the regular expression is not closed, or has a flag other than c (case-sensitive).

regex_badge.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab → Filter bar: small dim lowercase tag at the end of the filter row, shown while the filter text is a valid /regex/ pattern to signal regex matching is on.

all.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu → Group by: checkable menu item that shows all servers in one flat list without grouping headings.

by_client.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu → Group by: checkable menu item that groups the Explorer's servers under headings for the client each connection is assigned to.

by_environment.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu → Group by: checkable menu item that groups the Explorer's servers by environment (Local, Dev, Test, Staging, Production).

by_project.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu → Group by: checkable menu item that groups the Explorer's servers under headings for the project each connection belongs to.

by_server.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu → Group by: checkable menu item that groups connections under their server (host) name.

explorer_options_tooltip.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer tab header: tooltip on the vertical three-dot icon at the right of the Explorer/Library tabs that opens the Explorer options menu (grouping, manage connections, collapse, refresh).

library_options_tooltip.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Library tab header: tooltip on the vertical three-dot icon at the right of the Explorer/Library tabs, shown while Library is selected, that opens the Library options menu.

filter_button.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Library tab → Action bar: small button with a search icon that opens a filter field for narrowing the saved query library by name.

new_folder_button.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Library tab → Action bar: small button with a plus icon that starts creating a new folder in the saved query library.

save_query_button.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Library tab → Action bar: small button with a save icon that saves the active query tab into the SQL library.

collapse_all.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu: menu item that collapses every expanded node in the Explorer object tree.

group_by.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu: non-clickable section heading at the top, above the grouping choices (All, By client, By project, etc.).

manage_connections.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu: menu item below the grouping choices that opens the connection manager to edit, add, or delete saved connections.

refresh.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Explorer options menu: last menu item, which reloads the schema (databases, tables, and other objects) shown in the Explorer tree.

explorer.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Panel tabs: first tab at the top of the sidebar that shows the Explorer, the tree of connected servers and their database objects.

library.location: Workbench → Sidebar → Panel tabs: second tab at the top of the sidebar that shows the Library of saved SQL queries and folders.

account_signed_in_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left icon cluster: tooltip on the account icon while the user is signed in to their SQLLY account (the icon turns green); clicking opens the account details.

account_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left icon cluster: tooltip on the first, person-shaped icon when not signed in; clicking it opens the account / sign-in surface.

diagnostics_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left icon cluster: tooltip on the fourth icon, which toggles the diagnostics log console and can carry a red badge with the error count.

security_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left icon cluster: tooltip on the third, shield icon that opens the security settings surface.

settings_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left icon cluster: tooltip on the second, gear icon that opens the Settings window.

label.location: Workbench → Status bar → Right cluster: short text label next to the command icon; clicking it opens the Command Palette.

tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Right cluster: tooltip on the Commands button that names the Command Palette and its keyboard shortcut (⌘K).

disconnected.location: Tab switcher → Tab rows: dim text in a tab's connection trail (where client, project, environment, server, and database normally appear) when that tab has no active connection.

not_connected.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left cluster: connection label shown in place of the server name when no connection is active or the active connection is unhealthy.

dev.location: Connection environment names → Dev (development): shown as the environment badge in the status bar, on Welcome-screen connection cards, and in connection details such as the delete-connection and query-resume dialogs.

local.location: Connection environment names → Local (a database on this machine): shown on Welcome-screen connection cards and in connection details such as the delete-connection and query-resume dialogs; no status-bar badge.

production.location: Connection environment names → Production (live system): shown as the environment badge in the status bar, on Welcome-screen connection cards, and in delete-connection and query-resume dialogs.

staging.location: Connection environment names → Staging (pre-release copy): shown as the environment badge in the status bar, on Welcome-screen connection cards, and in delete-connection and query-resume dialogs.

test.location: Connection environment names → Test (testing system): shown as the environment badge in the status bar, on Welcome-screen connection cards, and in delete-connection and query-resume dialogs.

unset.location: Connection environment names → Unset (no environment assigned): appears on Welcome-screen connection cards and in delete-connection and query-resume dialogs; no status-bar badge.

error_plural.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left cluster: dim indicator shown while IntelliSense has hit two or more internal errors for the active tab; {count} is the number of errors.

error_singular.location: Workbench → Status bar → Left cluster: dim indicator shown when IntelliSense has hit exactly one internal error for the active tab; {count} is 1 (singular form).

copy_open_tooltip.value: 点击以复制并打开此消息
copy_open_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Message area: tooltip on a copyable status message (errors and other long messages); clicking copies the full text and opens it in a readable dialog.

locked.location: Workbench → Status bar → Right badges: amber all-caps chip shown while connected to a Production-environment connection whose production safety lock is engaged (write protection on).

unlocked.location: Workbench → status bar → production chip while writes are temporarily unlocked: uppercase environment label followed by the unlock countdown in {remaining}.

locked.location: Workbench → status bar → read-only connection chip while writes are locked: connection mode label.

unlocked.location: Workbench → status bar → read-only connection chip while writes are temporarily unlocked: mode label followed by the unlock countdown in {remaining}.

direct_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar: tooltip on the green connection dot when queries go straight from this app to the database; {server} is the server's display name.

not_connected_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar: tooltip on the red connection dot shown when there is no active connection, so queries have no route.

relay_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar: tooltip on the green connection dot for a remote connection, showing the path queries take; {relay_host} is the relay server, {bridge_name} the bridge device, {server} the database server.

many.location: Workbench → status bar → background-task chip with multiple running tasks: plural task count in {count}.

one.location: Workbench → status bar → background-task chip with exactly one running task: singular task count.

pending.location: Workbench → status bar → manual-commit chip: transaction mode followed by the number of uncommitted statements in {count}.

app_store_tooltip.value: Mac App Store 版本 — 通过 App Store 获取更新
app_store_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Version label: tooltip in the Mac App Store edition, explaining that SQLLY does not check for updates itself because updates come through the App Store.

available.location: Workbench → status bar → update-available chip: alert naming the newer application version in {version}, prefixed with a lowercase v.

available_tooltip.value: 有可用更新 — 点击查看
available_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Version label: tooltip shown when a newer version is available; clicking the version opens the update details.

check_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Version label: tooltip shown when no update is known yet; clicking the version checks for a newer release now.

download_tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Update chip: tooltip on the accent-coloured chip naming the new version; clicking it shows the release notes and download.

tooltip.location: Workbench → Status bar → Right cluster: tooltip on the percentage label (for example 100%) that opens the editor zoom control.

copied_status.location: Workbench → Status bar: success message shown after the Copy button in the status message detail dialog puts the full message on the clipboard.

copy_button.location: Status message detail dialog → Footer buttons (copy): button at the bottom of the dialog (opened by clicking a status-bar message) that copies the full message text to the clipboard.

error_title.location: Status message detail dialog → Title bar (error): dialog title used when the clicked status-bar message is an error; the full red error text is shown below it.

message_title.location: Status message detail dialog → Title bar (message): dialog title used when the clicked status-bar message is informational or a success (neither an error nor a warning).

warning_title.location: Status message detail dialog → Title bar (warning): dialog title used when the clicked status-bar message is a warning; the full warning text is shown below it.

account_fallback.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: stand-in inserted into “Signed in as …” when the store account has no email address on record; lowercase, used mid-sentence.

account_row.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: first detail line under the heading, naming the store account this app is signed in to; {email} is the account email address.

activate.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Pairing view: primary button under the large pairing code; opens the store's device registration page in the web browser so the user can sign in and claim this device.

retry.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Failed view: primary button shown when getting a pairing code from the store failed; requests a fresh pairing code.

sign_out_switch.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: outline button under the account and device lines that signs out and starts a new pairing so another account can sign in.

device_fallback.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: stand-in inserted as the device name in the “Device: …” line when this computer's name cannot be read; lowercase.

device_row.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: dim second detail line identifying this computer; {device} is the computer name, {device_id} the store's device identifier.

heading.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Body heading: large bold heading at the top of the window body, shown in every state (checking, pairing, signed in, failed).

window_title.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Title bar: title shown in the window's title bar (and window menus) for the separate store sign-in window.

no_email.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: stand-in shown in parentheses in the “Account: …” line when the signed-in store account has no email address.

paired_fallback.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Signed-in view: stand-in placed inside the parentheses of the “Device: …” line when the store returned no device identifier; means the device is paired.

browser_instructions.value: 会打开您的浏览器，通过 Google、Microsoft、GitHub、Apple、密钥或电子邮件登录。此窗口会自动完成。
browser_instructions.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Pairing view: small dim explanation under the activate button, telling the user which sign-in options the browser page offers and that this window completes on its own.

code_label.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Pairing view: dim label directly above the large pairing code the user confirms on the store's web page; ends with a colon.

awaiting_claim.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: progress text shown under the pairing code while the app polls the store, waiting for the user to finish signing in in the browser.

checking_account.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: progress text shown immediately when the window opens, while the saved sign-in is read from the keychain.

getting_pairing_code.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Pairing progress text: progress text shown in the body and status line while the app requests a pairing code from the store (first open, retry, or after signing out).

keychain_save_failed.value: 已登录，但保存到钥匙串失败：{error}
keychain_save_failed.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: red error shown when the browser sign-in succeeded but the session could not be stored in the OS keychain; {error} is the keychain error.

pairing_task_failed.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: red technical error shown when the background task that requests a pairing code crashed or was cancelled; {error} is the internal error text.

poll_task_failed.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: red technical error shown when the background task checking for the browser sign-in crashed, which stops the waiting; {error} is the internal error.

signed_in.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: confirmation shown when the window opens already signed in or once the browser sign-in completes; {email} is the account email or a stand-in.

waiting_with_error.location: SQLLY Store Sign In window → Status line: progress text shown when one check for the browser sign-in failed temporarily and waiting continues; {error} is the error from that attempt.

connected.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken for a tab with an active connection.

deleted_on_disk.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken when the tab's backing file was deleted on disk.

disconnected.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken for a tab without an active connection.

modified_on_disk.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken when the tab's backing file changed on disk.

running.location: Workbench → Query tab strip → Tab tooltip and accessibility text: lowercase state word added to the comma-separated tab status when a query is currently executing in that tab.

selected.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken for the currently selected tab.

unsaved.location: Workbench → editor tab → accessibility announcement: lowercase state spoken for a tab with unsaved changes.

connected.location: Workbench → All Tabs menu → clean, connected, idle row: query name and server without additional state text.

connected_running.location: Workbench → All Tabs menu → clean, connected, running row: query name and server followed by the running state.

dirty.location: Workbench → All Tabs menu → dirty, unconnected, idle row: bullet marking unsaved changes before the query name.

dirty_connected.location: Workbench → All Tabs menu → dirty, connected, idle row: bullet marking unsaved changes before the query name and server.
